subject: The Momentum is Real in CA-32
body:
This moment is here--let's take it!

| | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=720b1304d2&e=53c7d12fc7)
| | | | | | Dear Peter,
**Our momentum in CA-32 is growing** — and voters across the district are ready for leadership that listens, shows up, and fights for working people.
Over the past few months, we’ve earned new community endorsements, built local grassroots support, and connected with voters who believe CA-32 deserves real solutions and a stronger voice in Congress.
Now, we’re taking a major next step.
[**We’ve officially filmed our first campaign commercia l**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=ca1f209c9f&e=53c7d12fc7)—an exciting milestone and an opportunity to introduce a bold new vision for CA-32.
Filming the ad was only the beginning. Now we need to make sure voters actually see it.
[**Getting our message on television, online, and across the district takes real resources, and every contribution helps us reach more voters as we build this movement.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=de96cfede8&e=53c7d12fc7)
Because the truth is: people are struggling.
Families are being crushed by the cost of living. Rent keeps rising. Healthcare is unaffordable. Young people are drowning in student debt. Working families are being asked to do more with less while Washington continues to protect the status quo.
CA-32 deserves a fighter in Congress who will speak up about the issues impacting everyday people.
I’ll fight for:
• Medicare for all• Housing for all• Higher wages and union power• Tuition-free college• Cancel student debt• Green New Deal• Abolish ICE• Reproductive freedom• LGBTQ+ rights• End corporate corruption• Lock up the Epstein criminals
**This campaign is powered by people — not corporate PAC money.** If you believe it’s time for leadership that puts CA-32 first, I’m asking you to stand with us today.
[**Chip in $26 or whatever feels right — and help us get this message in front of voters across the district.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=7f13c823a5&e=53c7d12fc7) Thank you for believing in this movement and for helping us build something powerful together.**No PAC money. No AIPAC. Just people-powered change.**

And it’s worth fighting for. In Congress, Doris has remained focused on strengthening our public schools—supporting teachers, investing in classrooms, and ensuring that every student has access to the tools they need to succeed in a modern economy. But Trump’s GOP has slashed and frozen federal funding for public schools. [Last July](http://links.matsuiforcongress.com/s/c/77kVNDB9BGMe_cIlWMDfSroffOe5UPHzHyXYLhj0FN4ZUSOCwp8Zj6cXQAB57JmnNHDMK6o-_lLSHcX3hhY_ne1JWVyTRdwRv-X-KLNp0xenLhUFRJQO9jXMO_O7BPTQ-i16xis3jcTCLyZGoK1jSJnz_aVk403iMonXIiGlWz0w-kAXMAe2hovR3W0IsdsF2V84PePK0qeYOPiKXgJcdyvTr4xNaISMX-yQg8--8AAj5wy5YO8SmX1w81XXaX6wTT3saqBU9OpKu85TA6c4uwkt9FRd3SWNFEZYsP4__4BeEtjiQxwr1CM5TWAKaeudTPYWl_-3jjy9ik8VseKyWLglKqDdwCUVvIfZ7nEKjS7PxxtL83TLnhQa-S7x_9aCEzEsNFfucGD1fZfAJGgXbMinDXRWX45YFojfjO9NwAUoFShjItYwH40KezWLT8V87Ka1YKSddD1FN0tysLj6k3j-s4D9pNsbUhWYD8wpfHcjv_8IOEPcE476z86aEY1i9ZbfgfPL3g/29evL9s-_F7kHJZCYCxJtaZYQfACM7Xv/20), his Department of Education withheld $833 million from the California Department of Education, and $232 million of that was appropriated directly to effective instruction. clean_body: Public education has always been one of the clearest reflections of who we are as a country. | | | Friend, Public education has always been one of the clearest reflections of who we are as a country. And it’s worth fighting for. In Congress, Doris has remained focused on strengthening our public schools—supporting teachers, investing in classrooms, and ensuring that every student has access to the tools they need to succeed in a modern economy. But Trump’s GOP has slashed and frozen federal funding for public schools. , his Department of Education withheld $833 million from the California Department of Education, and $232 million of that was appropriated directly to effective instruction. Right now, our schools are still feeling the effects of national education budget cuts. You may already know that the Sacramento City Unified School District is facing a and underenrollment, which are forcing them to close up to four schools over the next five years. This is unacceptable, and it’s why we need to re-elect Representative Matsui. Peter, I'm emailing you more motivated than ever before.

**Republicans passed their racist, outrageous gerrymandered districts in Tennessee that eliminate District 9 as the only majority-Black and majority-Democratic district in our state.**

They have cheated their way into a map that favors Republicans, where politicians are picking their voters instead of voters picking their leaders.

We need to call this what it is: **this new map is a political lynching** — an affront to justice and the fight for equality.

My heart aches for my hometown of Memphis, where I was born and raised and where generations of my family are buried. [](https://jj-p.org/l/VpjqT7XLNUPc) **But I refuse to give in to despair. Don't give up hope, Peter.** The fight still carries on, renewed with urgency as we work to restore the rights that our ancestors marched, prayed, bled, and died for.

The index therefore falls short ... It follows that the office has not made a prima facie showing of privilege.... (existence of attorney-client relationship required to show privilege). Judicial Watch additionally argues that the trial court erred by not analyzing whether the attorney general’s office properly redacted the names of States United employees “principally responsible for the engagement” from the engagement letter. The unredacted portions of the letter do not provide any context as to these employees’ roles within States United. Even assuming that they were attorneys and the office had validly claimed privilege, an attorney’s identity generally falls outside the privilege’s protections.... And, to the extent the office might have some valid basis for the redaction, neither the index nor the context of the letter itself supplies it. We therefore conclude that the attorney general’s office has not met its burden of showing that it adequately searched its records ... The office was not entitled to disregard Judicial Watch’s unambiguous records request in favor of its own, narrower interpretation. * For the foregoing reasons, we vacate the trial court’s judgment and remand this case for further proceedings consistent with this opinion. (A November 2024 report [] revealed correspondence between the Arizona attorney general’s office and the nonprofit States United Democracy Center in the lead-up to the state’s prosecution tied to Donald Trump’s 2020 presidential campaign.) We are excited that the court has slapped back the unlawful secrecy about anti-Trump lawfare abuse by Arizona’s AG Kris Mayes. We are pushing hard in court for full disclosure about the details of what looks to be a conspiracy by the AG’s office to punish Trump supporters for exercising their fundamental rights. In November 2026, we received records [] from the Michigan Department of Attorney General in a Michigan Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request that show the state’s coordination with the nonprofit States United Democracy Center, which pushed indictments [] of President Donald Trump’s supporters, lawyers, activists, and Republican Party officials who disputed the 2020 election. Indictments of Trump alternative electors by Michigan Democratic Attorney General Dana Nessel were thrown out [] by a judge earlier this year. The documents suggest a broad conspiracy by several states to prosecute Americans over 2020 election disputes. In April 2026, we received records [] from the State of Nevada Office of Attorney General in a Nevada Public Records Act lawsuit that show the state’s close coordination with States United Democracy Center. We continue to work to obtain records from Wisconsin []. JUDICIAL WATCH SUES FOR RECORDS ON NEW JERSEY ICE FACILITY BREACH You’ll recall the day Newark Mayor Ras Baraka and three Democratic members of Congress breached the Delaney Hall Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detention facility in New Jersey. We are seeking all audio and video from the scene of this incident, which could have easily escalated. The continued anti-ICE rhetoric from the radical Left is putting lives in danger. We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit [] against the U.S. Department of Homeland Security seeking audio and video recordings, as well as inter-agency communications, related to a May 9, 2025, breach (Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security [ (No. 1:26-cv-01539)). We sued after Homeland Security failed to respond to a November 2025 FOIA request for: All audio recordings or video footage of the May 2025 incident at the Delaney Hall Detention Center in New Jersey during which public officials and other protesters attempted to enter the facility illegally. All records of communication between any official or employee of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement and any official or employee of any federal branch, department, or agency regarding the incident. Baraka was arrested at the scene for trespassing and released hours later. Representatives Rob Menendez Jr., Bonnie Watson Coleman, and LaMonica McIver—also present with a group of protesters—entered the facility grounds when security gates opened to admit an ICE bus. The Department of Homeland Security stated [ “These members of Congress storming into a detention facility goes beyond a bizarre political stunt and puts the safety of our law enforcement agents and detainees at risk. Members of Congress are not above the law and cannot illegally enter detention facilities. Had these members requested a tour, we would have facilitated a tour of the facility.” In June 2025, the U.S. Department of Justice announced [] that McIver “was charged in a three-count indictment for allegedly impeding and interfering with federal officers.” In February 2026, we filed a FOIA lawsuit [] for video footage and photographs of the attack on ICE’s Prairieland Detention Facility in Alvarado, TX, on July 4, 2025 (Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security [ (No.1:26-cv-00331)). In December 2025, we sued [] the Department of Homeland Security for records on migrants who entered the United States from 2020–2025, using arrest warrants and removal orders as proof of identification. In November 2025, we sued Evanston, IL, Mayor Daniel Biss [] for records related to obstruction of federal immigration enforcement, as well as Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs [] for records regarding her office reportedly ordering state police and the National Guard to withhold cooperation from federal immigration enforcement authorities. In December 2025 we pointed out [] that in just two states with “sanctuary” policies, nearly 9,000 criminal aliens were released from jails and prisons since January 20, defying Immigration and Customs Enforcement detainers to deport them. In October 2025, we reported [] on a Homeland Security Task Force (HSTF), established by Trump on the day of his inauguration to tackle a pandemic of transnational organized crime created by the Biden administration’s “disgraceful” open border policies, had made thousands of arrests and seized over 1,000 illegal firearms, 91 tons of drugs and $3 million in currency. CHINESE MAN GETS $59 MILLION IN COVID RELIEF, LAUNDERS HALF TO CHINA Are you at all surprised that when the government started giving out your tax dollars fraudsters saw an opportunity and acted? Our Corruption Chronicles blog reports []. Though it has been years since half a dozen laws were passed to dole out trillions of dollars in COVID-19 relief, fraud and corruption continue to plague the mammoth pandemic cash giveaway with a recent case involving a California man of Chinese descent who fraudulently collected tens of millions of dollars and laundered the proceeds to China. It is like a kick in the gut for American taxpayers, who continue to get fleeced all these years later by the pandemic measures—including the $2.1 trillion Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security Act [] (CARES Act) and $1.9 trillion American Rescue Plan [ were sold as necessary to provide economic relief to workers, families, small business, industry sectors and others affected by the 2020 public health crisis. The reality is that corruption is so rampant in all the pandemic relief programs that the Department of Justice (DOJ) created a special COVID-19 Fraud Enforcement Task Force (CFETF) a few years ago to crack down on scams and recover some of the stolen funds. Shortly after its creation, the task force exposed over $2 billion lost [] [ fraud with more than 3,500 defendants criminally charged. That was two years ago and the problem continues. In this latest case Bruce Jin of Los Angeles operated a sophisticated scheme that presented fake businesses as legitimate ones that sold personal protective equipment during the COVID-19 pandemic, allowing them to exploit emergency relief funds. Federal prosecutors say Jin stole $59 million in pandemic relief funds and transferred more than half of it to China using accounts at banks across the United States created with stolen identities. This month Jin was sentenced to 12 years in prison for conspiracy to commit wire fraud and conspiracy to launder monetary instruments in the amount of approximately $59 million, according to an announcement [] [ by the DOJ. “Unnamed members of the conspiracy, including some believed to be located in China, established thousands of accounts at banks across the United States using the personal identifying information (“PII”) of identity theft victims,” the agency writes, adding that from there, fraudulent claims were generated and paid to the accounts. How could a years-long scheme that siphoned tens of millions of taxpayer dollars using the nation’s banking system avoid law enforcement detection? It is a question many have asked since Uncle Sam started handing out pandemic cash. Judicial Watch has investigated and reported extensively on the fraud, including government employees taking advantage of the lax oversight. A few years ago, Internal Revenue Service (IRS) employees were charged [] [ stealing over a million dollars from pandemic relief programs to buy luxury goods, fancy cars, and travel. They easily withdrew the money by filing several false loan applications with two of the federal stimulus programs launched under the CARES Act. The disgraced federal employees used the illegally obtained pandemic relief funds to buy expensive designer clothes (Gucci), a fancy imported car (Mercedes-Benz), jewelry, trips to Las Vegas, manicures, and massages. The leftover cash was deposited into personal investment accounts. Each of the defendants submitted multiple fraudulent applications seeking at least tens of thousands of dollars in relief funds. Even incarcerated felons have defrauded COVID relief programs from jail. A few years ago, a gang member serving 19 years in a California state prison operated a scheme that collected $25 million in pandemic unemployment benefits [] and another jailed convict used stolen identities to claim more than $1 million [] in unemployment payments. In the first scheme the 31-year-old inmate submitted millions of dollars in fraudulent pandemic unemployment claims using stolen personal information of other incarcerated individuals as well as other civilians. Of the $25 million in fraudulent claims the government actually paid out $5.5 million, and the money was used to buy vehicles, jewelry, and other items. In the million-dollar scam, another California state inmate collected pandemic unemployment relief money using the personal information, including Social Security numbers, of fellow prisoners and other individuals to submit fraudulent claims from his jail cell. In the claims the inmate wrote that candidates had lost jobs from businesses or were unable to find employment due to the pandemic. It was that easy. BIDEN JUDGE RULES MUSLIM TERRORIST HAS RIGHT TO KEEP HIJAB IN PRISON Islamic law is creeping into our society more and more these days. It’s in federal prisons now, as our Corruption Chronicles_ blog reveals []. In a troubling development, a terrorist front group that has gained tremendous influence by suing and lobbying to embed Islam in American public institutions has succeeded in getting the nation’s federal prison system to submit to Islamic law. The case involves the Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR), a radical Muslim charity that was named as a co-conspirator in a federal terror-finance case [] [ the Hamas front group Holy Land Foundation. CAIR was founded in 1994 by three Middle Eastern extremists (Omar Ahmad, Nihad Awad and Rafeeq Jaber) who ran the American propaganda wing of Hamas, known then as the Islamic Association for Palestine. For years CAIR has used the U.S. legal system and widespread pressure campaigns to influence various areas of American public life, most recently by strong-arming Maryland’s largest taxpayer-funded school district [] [ give students the day off in observance of a Muslim religious holiday known as Eid al-Fitr. Now the extremist group that claims to advance Muslim civil rights is celebrating a huge legal victory that will impact a central component of the U.S. criminal justice system, the Federal Bureau of Prisons [] [). The agency with over 33,000 employees oversees the custody of some 154,000 federal inmates throughout the country. The FOB as well as the state prison system bans hats and other head covers for security and safety reasons. A few years ago, a Somali Muslim woman, Muna Jama, was required to remove her hijab—a head scarf used as a symbol of modesty in the Islamic dress code—during booking and official prison identification photos were taken. Jama was convicted and sentenced to 12 years in federal prison [ conspiracy to provide material support to the Somali terrorist group al-Shabaab, which has strong ties to al-Qaeda. Jama helped operate an online network that raised and disbursed money to al-Shabaab for jihadists plots, military operations and safehouses. CAIR sued the BOP on the terrorist’s behalf, asserting that the prison system’s policy is unconstitutional and violates her religious rights. Forcing the convicted extremist to remove her hijab, photographing her uncovered and requiring her to carry that uncovered photo on an ID she must present throughout the prison everyday is a violation of federal law, according to the complaint []. Jama’s faith requires her to always wear a hijab when she is in mixed-gender spaces outside of her immediate family, the court document states, adding that her religious beliefs are deeply rooted in Islamic texts and teachings. “Her hijab is a pillar of her religious practice and integral to her identity as a Muslim woman,” CAIR’s lawsuit reads. Appearing in public or being photographed without the and having that photo accessible to strangers is a serious breach of Jama’s faith and deeply humiliating, the group states. As a result, the convicted terrorist “has sustained damages, and has suffered and continues to suffer mental anguish, physical and emotional distress, humiliation, and embarrassment,” according to the complaint. A Biden-appointed federal judge in Minnesota, Jeffrey M. Bryan, agreed and recently issued an order [] affirming the rights of incarcerated Muslim women to wear a hijab despite established security protocols banning all head covers. The judge also directs the FOB to destroy all of Jama’s booking photographs without her hijab, writing that “the retention of Jama’s uncovered photo further substantially burdens Jama’s religious exercise because the photo’s mere existence means a non-familial male could potentially view the photo, thereby violating Jama’s religious beliefs.” The case is the latest of many in which CAIR has altered the way American law enforcement agencies do their job. Years ago, an Atlanta jail caved into CAIR’s demand that Muslim inmates be allowed to wear hijabs []. [] Under Obama CAIR got the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to purge anti-terrorism training curricula of material coined “offensive” to Muslims, a scandal uncovered by Judicial Watch and documented in an in-depth report []. The terror front group also got several local police departments and the U.S. military to eliminate anti-terrorism training materials [] and instructors deemed anti-Muslim. At CAIR’s request, Obama’s Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, General Martin Dempsey, actually ordered the U.S. military to “scour its training material to ensure it doesn’t contain anti-Islamic content.” Until next week... _→ He’s called for networks to be pulled down and for journalists to be fired.

subject: Kristen was trapped in an attic. Then someone acted.
body:
A rescue team changed Kristen's life. Another mission begins in Phoenix.

| | |
---
| |
---
| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there.
Alone. There was no bathroom.
Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex.
Over. And over. And over. **This is the reality of child trafficking.**
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkepquc0g5u4e3b5pato6c5t6ta414794i9f4qsg_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)
---
[ Send help to children waiting](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsaru68uttv8o1qccmu8jkpfsj6n7svpkkf0tbg8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)
---
Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...**she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. **They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. **Free.** Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal**.**

**She took the first step toward healing.** **This rescue was possible because people chose to act.**
---
[ Send help to children waiting](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5q1gcr5raviq43k40r9eb93sih3votlefkhn7co_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)
---
The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to _stop_ _ __the sale __of God 's children._ Inspired by the film _Sound of Freedom_ , the Foundation works around the world to **prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children.** Our mission is simple. **To stop the sale of God 's children.** And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our **Freedom Strike Force** partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. **Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues.**
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi28sprjsc3kvp4c9sl6imdaqtn33l92hqvc0mi8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4m4gidrfgpv4nsej9p3cbtm6gg8dgro40icbsi0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)
---
| | Children like Kristen are waiting. But these missions cannot happen without support from people who care.
---
[ Send help to children waiting](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt9lqgs15lle15kqhehv2lkk1h11372f9vc2j1k8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)
---
That is why I am reaching out to you today. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z41vssnpfbh23g24idj6b71g2ma05gpt9cima7vo_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfc6jins082ubniu148na1rsqqgk2g09bavvga50_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)**[Would you consider making your first gift of $30, $60, $130 or whatever you can do right now to help rescue children from trafficking?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdfmc49r7r4rissf5o4mi5eic59rgcftpfo1a718_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)** Your donation today can help:
---
* Train officers to find trafficked children
* Support rescue operations
* Provide food, clothing, and care for survivors
* Help children begin the journey to healing

---
When I first heard the stories of trafficked children, I asked myself a question. _What if it were my child?_ I could not stay silent.
And you do not have to either. **Friend, will you please help rescue the next child today?** Your gift -- whatever God places on your heart -- will help bring freedom to children still waiting in the dark. **Together we can make sure more children hear the Sound of Freedom.** With gratitude and prayer,
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zavqjl82nn0ulg1rv74bhvupnca6vq5n7eh0iebg_rp22sh2s8i6epr0sph6apj1cjh2bs)
---
Eduardo Verastegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation
---
**P.S.** The cost to staff, equip, and execute a **Freedom Strike Force** **Training Camp** is $25,000. To raise these funds, I need Freedom Fighters like you to rally in support and sponsor this mission.

**Please pray about what you can do to help and donate today.**
---

## Court Overturns Democrats' Virginia Map
Virginia's Supreme Court on Friday [struck down the state's new congressional redistricting plan](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGPnDAQhX-N6byyxxhD4SIN3aVNiQweYCKDkT3s6v59tBelSH31e_r0vvfrY_oIlOjcfoYDPa95OvFVEzJjmZ5UNjopFIxUudDCdG4nvu4JFHRSWamGKQZKn1PbRL8iApoGvXauN6BB22b3cQFQw7pYo_vWaWfCPNvBRpgHZ6zWDfk3TVk1aKU6ax5Gta6NziH20YBbRKswEufy-J3p5B3X9JmfWB5LPprkd-arCvNDwChg5B13SumdCRgLbncKTPkUMC75LiznwJywChht3w2d7uQ_TVnvq-CB8m-Rc61Y5X_y8giX_JI_KDKW481pio_Xi1Ki2jnRqu0I9DWg4W89-vTwJwAA__-IKovB), delivering a major setback to Democrats in a nationwide gerrymandering battle against Republicans for an edge in this year's midterm elections. ## Canvas Hack Hits Texas at Finals
A cyberattack knocked out [Canvas](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O4zAQg59G7hTI8n-h4hp3e-2VxlgaR0ImVqCZxOu3P3hfYRs2BPiR_Pe1fEGitN__whOdfG952fFgQhEsSwT_wMIgAv7BPuZMHLMgLdbYXptOm2kJkOhc2iq41YSprtDVwzA2tm2nqYoOgsFpCziMYWhwW21jsA9j12PT1GjGKrkrzHRmqmtTN-OtW7dm7NfB99bYDoJqDYYkudwkouA38EZn_mC5-fysyEWRF6vmj7KzsvNxHLcHg1ymsvO1RtmZsgdSdr5Qys6mu2RUdvawf4C1P1csjP5dkpx6LQg-6vR8gRfWEvObYQ-s86Z9JsI7sn7v6YOFkyRkDay3tAOxpvzDrYoLryMRJe4H1Zr7ExL9FJbf3fxx9n8AAAD__yZjk-Y), the widely used learning management platform, at the worst possible moment for thousands of Texas students--finals week. The hacking group [ShinyHunters](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQgOGngc3obIOBwUMXtnTtiA77iK0YHNlOSN6-ou0bdDvppF_33ddlvqAPfr9-4ka6vNY473TkQKVQmh2aG6WMpaC5ZeNiDNnFQmEWIBSDjsE4W_ThPbe11QvYkdeked8PUrTtONZOc8OVVHYkRKmMXK2Cdh2GXliQCMBrr88YdDByDlwOTbesclBLb5QA0aGtWiDrS0xNcVTohXkN7_ik1Ji41UG7Uu65kh-VmCoxHcfRmCWfinNfiekcKzGZ90Lpl8Kye5zAzAzuT8wsEKbd71d2D1jWmDa2xsT-xAxNijmzx1mpk7b3w4fgs-qrFq4b-vBzSPnf-55afAcAAP__PIiHdw) claimed responsibility, saying nearly 9,000 schools worldwide were hit and threatening to leak billions of private student records unless Instructure, Canvas's parent company, paid a ransom. Cybersecurity analysts describe the group as a loose U.S.-U.K. network of young hackers, the same outfit previously linked to the Ticketmaster breach. Texas institutions caught in the outage [span the state](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uKiEURp-G6TDA_FJQ3GY6b3vKyQY2QsTBwHbUtz_RVzj1l29lZf2ctzOknPbLf7ihoVco247PlpEI6xbBXbE2IAJ3bS6WklsshHlTQk1cjFzozUPK723ovLHCa9mhkfO89GoYtO6iwXmYhQhWaw39Ar73Fp2Veh4xLEFhl8wHJkahpRSyX06jDf0y2dlNSqgRPBsE-kSlnigi4QtayO9yYD25cuuyiUT3xvp_TK1MrWCd7D8LU-u9NGJqbeVBEaER_775Y08H1pYoYeMQAjpCzz0QcFsRXORpP0o-0n7hDvYDGm8l0BMqMrVKLSaxTJKptavG358p59SmmQ3icoOUv1b0t5aHUb8BAAD__yHdis0): UT Austin, Texas A&M, UT San Antonio, the University of Houston, Baylor, Texas State, Alamo Colleges, and multiple school districts, including Houston ISD and Katy ISD. UIW extended finals deadlines, and UTSA rescheduled assignments. Canvas was [largely restored by Friday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU9jMiNjjIHAwSZks-mGqLCLsdUGj6iaprn9it69wSSVlPTf_-_Px_wBKaf98zds6Pi1lnnHkzIy4zFH8A88CJjBP8jHUjLFwphnrbSVqpNqnAOkfM2mCm5RYWwqdE3fD602Zhyr6MC2prVoldWL0V3XmwB-RBzWAddlCFVyd5jq1Ng0qmmHulvWdrBL761WuoMgjMKQuBw1R2R8Aa35Kk88al-2KrvI_EWi_SX0JPR0nmf9IOD7KfTE6KPQ040QelLdfQahJ38tePwbJmNikh72J5Ckixg3-U0Y5HJJjuWbYA8kyyr_G5BAck07ZJK5vCHV4cLXmXJOZHth1OcGKb_b8c-cPp3-GwAA___Wtow9), and commencement ceremonies at most Texas universities proceeded as planned. subject: Before Tuesday, May 12, Compare the Records
body:
| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/24ca7b4d988e/before-tuesday-may-12-compare-the-records?e=a0285cc040)
---
|

# Before Tuesday, May 12,
# Compare the Records

---
|
---
|
---
| |
Dear Friend,
Before you cast your vote, I encourage you to do something many politicians hope you won’t do:
**Research every name on your ballot.**
Look at the [sample ballot for your county](https://us.list-manage.com/19YwtE7JGu6?e=a0285cc040&c2id=b69667d9a89b37696c4f0b9977e6dc96 "https://apps.sos.wv.gov/elections/sampleballots").
Examine the record of every incumbent.
Ask whether they’ve actually delivered on the promises they made to West Virginians.
Then look closely at the candidates asking for your vote.
**Who has a proven record of leadership, service, and standing up for our values?**
Who has actually lived and worked in the real world — outside the political bubble of Washington, D.C.?
**Not a career Washington politician — but someone who has served West Virginians while continuing to live and work right here at home.**
Many candidates can make promises.
**Very few have a proven conservative record of serving the people of West Virginia in elected office.**
When you do that research, you’ll see this U.S. Senate race comes down to two serious candidates:
**Shelley Moore Capito and I.**
**My record is public.****My work is verifiable.**
And my life has been defined by service:
* U.S. Army Special Forces Green Beret
* Faith-driven husband and father raising my family right here in West Virginia
* Business owner working as both an attorney and a general contractor
* Lieutenant Colonel, West Virginia National Guard, with more than 25 years of service
* State Senator and committee chairman fighting for conservative values

If you do your research, you’ll also see that Shelley Moore Capito has increasingly moved away from many conservative voters in West Virginia.
Time and again, she has taken positions that do not reflect the values of many people in this state:
* Supported federal funding tied to red flag firearm initiatives
* Voted to codify same-sex marriage protections into federal law
* Taken inconsistent positions on abortion and Planned Parenthood funding
* Failed to lead on protecting girls’ sports
* Failed to champion the SAVE ACT to ensure only American citizens vote in American elections
* Sponsored the RESTRICT ACT, legislation many conservatives viewed as a threat to free speech protections online

**Conservative organizations have noticed.**
Liberty Score, CPAC, FreedomWorks, and Heritage Action have all given her a failing grade on key conservative votes.
I didn’t spend my life climbing the ladder in Washington politics.
**I spent it serving this country.** Building businesses.Raising a family.And fighting for the people of West Virginia in the real world.
**West Virginia deserves conservative leadership that will fight for our values, protect our freedoms, and put our people first.**
This election is too important for voters to rely on television ads, political consultants, or party talking points.
**Compare the records.****Compare the experience.****Compare the service.**
Then decide who has truly earned your vote.
**IT’S TIME FOR A CHANGE, WEST VIRGINIA!**
Thank you for standing with me,
**— Tom Willis**

name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: I wanted you to see this
body:
students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8f9uqm6pknj8etbn2k5a43oa9u55n8t88eq7q8g_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spj69pr4cdh2bs)
---
| | Friend,
---
I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvd28k3rhiito09una8pgsb54sieg4qijpg3ql2g_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spj69pr4cdh2bs)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zv4d2b020jm7ddmqs59j8ljnu81p3ekdm7mhpt4g_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spj69pr4cdh2bs)
---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvgv97ksd7lfrs3urk2atcfivdi1vn7n00njf9k0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spj69pr4cdh2bs)
---
That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**[Each activism kit costs $25 to pack and ship to a student chapter. Will you put one into a student's hands today?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1hfn9278uugmtvgmd0aa5vq2o17p69j84blh6r0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spj69pr4cdh2bs)**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zr8d1c8sc3gcuqo5l7b3sjd4a0j7lfojpob8399o_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spj69pr4cdh2bs)
---
Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines.

That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward.

That's how this movement actually scales.

Because the reality is, the demand is here now.

The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it.

And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward.

**[Please commit to sending an activism kit to a conservative student today-- and help us keep building a generation that's willing to stand up and fight for this country.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zokl9r45m6crcpdh28mblo0trmuvv7mlc7cb1io0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spj69pr4cdh2bs)**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhu8p66q6mrr1hv8v5o4vk53bsk96n739gdfhf8o_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spj69pr4cdh2bs)
---
One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you.

If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now.

Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school.

This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it.

And we don't take that lightly.

I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work.
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Andrew Sypher** Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA
---

---
**P.S.** Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture.

But moments like this don't sustain themselves.

If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple.

**We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. **

If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day.

If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

name: The PreBorn! Team
subject: Before she makes this decision
body:
This Mother’s Day, while many of us are celebrating the women who gave us life, there are women quietly deciding if they will become mothers at all.

| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5q5fbc8hgbeoiv9flksf002bb2atvcpogktuobo_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spgm4ob0cdh2bs)
---
Friend of Life, She’s sitting in her car, staring at the building in front of her, trying to convince herself this is the only way forward, even though something inside her keeps saying, _wait... just wait._ She tells herself she doesn’t have time to think. That if she slows down, she might not be able to go through with it. That it’s easier to just move forward with the abortion and deal with everything else later. No one has told her she can pause. No one has told her she can see her baby first. And if nothing interrupts this moment, her decision will be made in minutes. This is the reality for thousands of women right now. And it’s why this moment matters so much. Because when a woman is given the chance to see her baby on an ultrasound, something begins to change in a way that is hard to describe until you see it happen. The screen lights up, the heartbeat fills the room, and suddenly what felt distant and abstract becomes real. She’s no longer thinking about “getting through something.” She’s looking at her child. And in that moment, everything shifts. [**More than 80% of women choose life after seeing their baby on an ultrasound.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zodp04h4deigvpa4ptqriam7i0812h2vpb53mqko_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spgm4ob0cdh2bs) But what matters just as much is what happens after. Months from now, she is not trying to push down a memory or carry the weight of a decision she cannot undo. She is holding her baby. **[This Mother’s Day, while many of us are celebrating the women who gave us life, there are women quietly deciding if they will become mothers at all.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znstr3suusaasakdl31k6ve38a3b3tcbk0kq7ec0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0spgm4ob0cdh2bs)** You can step into that moment. $28 provides one ultrasound. And right now, that ultrasound could be the reason she pauses long enough to see, to understand, and to choose life. Will you help her before that moment passes?
---

body:
Abusing emergency powers is a fascist power grab. I’m not afraid to say what MAGA extremists are — and I’m not afraid to stand up and fight back.
| | | | | [](https://6oz8v8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001sxtN95SdMup9EjpqbwSNFhepl9wWKmOeZSH5Wv6IkbU6Vn2xcJecjE-y009x0zPoBu8j539hLIaKg60vQuOIIpVBPwugDgpCFMD5iJ8PZxeZrwbSy_Nq82yJ4tpMPVz7wTYbNy5SchTz16rkUeEVwo93kM4-_whvu41y7ZIZAxGhz4BvhRVVMPD8n9sA6LY5rV0R1qG9tLm0p4q7BLW97yaKlzuNtJ0w&c=7nRb9dMXwegtB9giqSXK8BSISed_fNp5kb6TFJlCIlerDb-ps5xY2Q==&ch=7dUXjvNQRvwT-7CWYoZKneCQPHZqbuHG4N4rKtWaIcR6A7FILnIgnQ==)

| | | |
Peter,
I'm not going to beat around the bush just because it hurts MAGA's feelings to say this: what we are seeing play out in Louisiana after the Supreme Court's infamous decision to reinstate Jim Crow in the South is fascism.
The GOP Governor of my state, Jeff Landry, saw an opportunity to undermine Black voters and weaken our voting power, and he acted swiftly to do so.
He cancelled an election that was already underway just hours after the Supreme Court gave the greenlight to spread minority voters out so thin across their district maps that they will no longer have any strength left in numbers.
Reports are now arriving that over 40,000+ voters had already cast ballots in my election. These ballots will no longer be counted. Those are my voters that they just disenfranchised with the stroke of a pen. But they've got another thing coming if they think we're going to take this lying down.
---
| | [](https://6oz8v8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001sxtN95SdMup9EjpqbwSNFhepl9wWKmOeZSH5Wv6IkbU6Vn2xcJecjE-y009x0zPoBu8j539hLIaKg60vQuOIIpVBPwugDgpCFMD5iJ8PZxeZrwbSy_Nq82yJ4tpMPVz7wTYbNy5SchTz16rkUeEVwo93kM4-_whvu41y7ZIZAxGhz4BvhRVVMPD8n9sA6LY5rV0R1qG9tLnenhuMll-IB1lhUhfvA_HW&c=7nRb9dMXwegtB9giqSXK8BSISed_fNp5kb6TFJlCIlerDb-ps5xY2Q==&ch=7dUXjvNQRvwT-7CWYoZKneCQPHZqbuHG4N4rKtWaIcR6A7FILnIgnQ==)

My name is Representative Cleo Fields. I represent the district at the heart of the racist Callais decision that gutted the landmark 1965 Voting Rights Act.
I represented parts of this district in Congress from 1993-1997. In 2024, I came back to serve the people of my district and my state once again.
I knew we had a fight on our hands with the MAGA movement, but I never imagined we would be staring down a fascist power grab like this, one that has already invalidated over 42,000 legally cast votes under the guise of a nonexistent "emergency."
The state's emergency powers to suspend or cancel elections are for times when severe natural disasters like Hurricane Katrina cripple our infrastructure and make holding an election impractical. They are not for partisan gerrymandering at the very last second when voters are already casting ballots in scheduled elections.
We must call this out as a fascist power grab motivated by race, plain and simple. I'm not afraid to say what MAGA extremists are -- and I'm not afraid to stand up and fight back.
My team and I are working overtime every single day to stop Landry and Trump from implementing their anti-democracy fascist agenda in Louisiana. If they can get away with it here, they can get away with it anywhere. [We only stop them if we stand united. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: US National Debt — The Only Math That Matters
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/usnationaldebt?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend,
Imagine your family spent more this year than you earned. It wouldn’t be comfortable, but you’d manage. Now imagine your family had spent more than it earned every single year since 2001. By now you’d be destitute.

Well, that is exactly what the federal government has been doing.

**For the past 25 years — ever since Bill Clinton left the White House — Washington has spent more than it has taken in. Every single year.**

The result is a national debt that now stands at $39 trillion.

**In 2001, the United States owed less than $6 trillion. Today we owe nearly $39 trillion. That means the federal debt has grown by $33 trillion in just 25 years.**
---
|
---
_$39 Trillion? That’s serious money_
| Here is the worrying part. In the entire 212 years from George Washington’s first inauguration through Bill Clinton’s last day in office — through the Civil War, the Great Depression, two World Wars, and the Cold War — the United States ran up $5.8 trillion in debt.

In the 25 years since, we have added $33 trillion more. **More than four-fifths of the total debt has been acquired in the past quarter-century.**

Millions, Billions, Trillions. Our brains are not wired to grasp numbers this large, so let me put it another way.

A million seconds ago was about 11 days ago. Late April. A billion seconds ago was 32 years ago — 1994 — when something called the World Wide Web was just getting started.

A trillion seconds ago? That was around 32,000 years ago. Woolly mammoths still roamed Europe, farming had not yet been invented, and no one (we think) had yet made it to North America.
That is what a trillion looks like. And we owe almost forty of them.

And the rate at which we acquire new debt is accelerating. Of that $39 trillion, $2.7 trillion was added in just the past year. **A staggering $10 trillion — more than 27 percent of every dollar America has ever borrowed — has been piled on in the past five years alone.**

The federal government now adds roughly $8 billion of new debt every single day.

**Great nations are rarely destroyed by external enemies. They are more often destroyed by debt.**

The historian Niall Ferguson has warned that when the crushing cost of servicing old debts begins to crowd out the essential investments that sustain national strength — especially defense — decline becomes almost inevitable.

**History is littered with cautionary tales. Habsburg Spain. Bourbon France. The Ottoman Empire. Each was once the greatest power on earth. Each was overstretched by debt.**

Ferguson identifies a critical threshold — sometimes called the “Ferguson limit” — beyond which a great power cannot long survive: the moment a nation spends more on debt interest than on defense. At that point, fiscal arithmetic begins to dismantle geopolitical power.

The United States is now flirting with that threshold. (What will it cost to replace those expensive munitions used in Iran this week?)

**A few months ago, I was at the Ole Miss game in Oxford when a B-2 stealth bomber flew over the stadium.** The crowd went wild. It was one of the most thrilling sights I have ever seen — a symbol of American strength, the kind of demonstration of raw power that not only keeps the United States secure but keeps the bad guys across the globe in line.
---
|
---
_B-2. One flew over Ole Miss ..._
| Each B-2 cost over $2 billion to build, which is why only 21 were ever produced. Keeping one in the air costs about $150,000 per hour.

The risk is that one day the United States — like Habsburg Spain — will simply not be able to afford the things that make us strong. And it isn’t just the defense budget at stake. Will America be able to pay its Medicaid bills? Its pensions? Its Social Security obligations?

**We pour enormous attention into elections and congressional redistricting. But unless we get the debt under control, none of that will matter.**

At the start of President Trump’s second term, I had high hopes. Elon Musk and DOGE talked seriously about reducing public spending. I hoped Congress might finally wake up and do its job.

But cutting spending alone will not be enough. **We also need economic growth — and I am confident we are on the cusp of a massive AI-driven productivity boom that could deliver it.** Spending restraint and growth, working together, could narrow the deficit over a decade or so. Eventually we could even begin to pay the debt itself down.

This — not the midterms, not the game of musical chairs over congressional districts — is what really matters.

**Controlling the deficit will decide whether our children’s children live better lives than we do, or whether we follow Europe down the path of higher taxes, rising costs, and demographic decay.**
---

---
| |
---
Yours in liberty,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
Mississippi Center for Public Policy

**The U.S. Dollar Threat to Your Retirement**
_**National debt is $39 trillion. BRICS is dismantling the dollar. The Fed keeps printing money.**_
---
Here’s the number you need to know: $192.

That’s what it takes to buy what $100 did in 2000.

Almost _double._

That means a lot fewer groceries. A lot less travel. A lot less money to leave your kids.

And if you’ve been in the War Room, you know the losses just keep getting worse.

Every dollar the Fed prints is like a tax on your savings.

Your retirement doesn’t just have to grow. It has to _outrun_ the shrinking dollar.

And you know it won’t change soon.

Vladimir Putin put it bluntly at the 2025 BRICS summit:
---
**“In 2024 ... the ruble, along with the currencies of friendly nations, accounted for 90% of Russia’s settlements with other BRICS states.”**
---
That’s not the whole world abandoning the dollar.

But it's a warning. And a clear attack on American retirement savings.

Take a hard look at your own retirement accounts...

Can they carry you through 20 or 30 years of higher and higher costs? **If the answer is no, you must check out Augusta’s[2026 Wealth Preservation Guide](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. Here’s what most people don’t realize until the window closes:
---
**Your retirement accounts are paper-based assets tied to markets that can swing wildly and a dollar that buys less every single year.**
---
Last year, a record percentage of Americans dipped into retirement accounts just to cover emergencies. Many aren't even saving for retirement anymore — they're surviving on it.

**But you have time to fix it.**

What retirement needs to survive is an asset outside the paper system — one that broadly diversifies risk.

That asset is **physical gold.**

No counterparty risk. Answers to no central bank. Outlasted every financial crisis in history.

And the **data backs it up.**

In 2025, gold was up 64.5% in a single year. More than nearly every other asset.

In early 2026, gold surged past $5,000 an ounce — with a record high of almost $5,600.

And here’s what most Americans haven’t heard, because the financial industry profits from keeping your money right where it is...
---
**Federal tax law gives you the right to move your IRA, 401(k) or other tax-advantaged retirement account directly into physical gold — in a gold IRA — without triggering taxes or penalties.**
---
It’s IRS-approved. And available right now to help you protect your future from this dollar-shrinking insanity.

[Download your FREE 2026 Wealth Preservation Guide today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "Download your FREE 2026 Wealth Preservation Guide today.") Don’t wait for someone in Washington to fix this.

Hi Derek — I’m Paulina, the DNC’s Deputy Chief Mobilization Officer.
I wanted to update you on my team’s work since the 2024 election — work that grassroots supporters like you helped fund.
I oversee our content and creative team, whose biggest function is to run our social media accounts. They work long hours, staying up late into the night when big news breaks, to make sure that Democratic messaging reaches as many people as possible, no matter the platform.
**And it’s working.** We’re growing rapidly on platforms like TikTok — where we’ve gone from having around 1 million followers in November of 2024 **to 5.4 million followers today.**
We also received **738 million impressions** last month — that’s 738 million times someone watched a TikTok, an Instagram reel, or read a tweet from The Democrats. What’s even more exciting is that 74.8% of our TikTok impressions came from people under the age of 35.
At the DNC, we hear a lot of feedback that Democrats need to do more to reach young people. Derek, this is how we do that.
And we’re not just posting about the chaos of the Trump administration — we’re using our platforms to share the work that Democrats are doing every day to make people’s lives better.
Winning the midterm elections is going to take Democrats giving it their all in every arena we have — on the ground, knocking doors, raising money, making calls, and, yes, posting on social media.
[**Your support powers _all_ of that work. So, can you chip in $7 to the DNC today to help us keep reaching voters — on social media, in their neighborhoods, and everywhere in between? body:
We need to pay attention to what’s going on at the USPS.
#

Friends: it’s Gabby Giffords. I wanted to make sure you saw this message from our team before the weekend ends.
If Donald Trump and the NRA get their way, the U.S. Postal Service could be on the verge of ending their century-old ban on mailing handguns. We need to speak out.
Please read the update below. Thank you.
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260509-1-b&t=1&akid=11459%2E3935704%2E5ROp0b)**

* * *

❗ Friends -- to everybody who cares about our movement for gun safety, please don’t skip this important message.
The Trump administration is trying to change the rules to let the USPS deliver guns through the mail — with no background checks, licensing, or training — and we need you to help fight back.

Since 1927, federal law has prohibited the United States Postal Service from carrying or delivering handguns as mail — with exceptions for members of the military, law enforcement, or licensed gun manufacturers or dealers.
Donald Trump is trying to change that.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260509-1-b&t=2&akid=11459%2E3935704%2E5ROp0b)
His Department of Justice recently issued a memorandum saying that they would no longer enforce this ban. Now, the USPS is proposing a change to their existing regulations.

If this rule goes into effect, it would mean people who shouldn’t have a gun will be able to go around state and federal laws and get a gun mailed to them.
**This change also means that gun traffickers have a new way to move firearms through America’s communities.**
At a time when gun violence is the #1 killer of kids and teenagers in our country...this rule would make us all less safe. We need to fight back.

You have helped us so much fighting back against extremist legislation and passing gun safety laws. Now, we need your support again to push back on this proposed rule.
[**Please, will you please donate $3 to help GIFFORDS PAC today? Our average online donation is around $27. Some give more, others give less. What matters most is that you are taking action today in the fight to make our communities safer.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260509-1-b&t=3&akid=11459%2E3935704%2E5ROp0b)

**In today 's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

---

name: Wes Moore
subject: I’m saying goodbye
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1374%2E1086043%2EyKd53x)
Today, I’m delivering the final commencement address at Valley Forge Military Academy -- a place that truly transformed me from an angry, complicated kid to a responsible, purposeful young man.
I want to share a bit about what is on my mind as I say goodbye to this place that was so integral to my story, Peter, but if you don’t have time to read through it all, I would deeply appreciate **[a contribution to power our re-election campaign.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260509-1.8LAdky&refcode=em-20260509-1&t=2&akid=1374%2E1086043%2EyKd53x)**
When my mother first sent me to the Forge, she saw military school as a last resort in response to a seemingly endless chain of misbehavior, both at home and at school. At age 11, I’d already felt handcuffs on my wrists. **I was not on a path to success.**
There was no overnight miracle when I started school there, but slowly, things changed. I learned about honor, code, and service. I started to take an interest in campus life, academics, and leadership positions -- and I rose up the ranks and became a first captain in command of around 800 cadets.
After graduation, I went on to study at Johns Hopkins and Oxford, deployed to Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne Division, ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country, and now, I serve as the 63rd governor of Maryland _and the first Black governor in the history of my state._
What saddens me most isn’t losing a place I once called home. My memories will forever live on with me.
**It saddens me that other young men like me will have one fewer avenue to challenge themselves and build their own pathway to success.**
Peter, at a time where our young men and boys are falling behind and feeling isolated, we have to offer more paths for connection and engagement.
I know Valley Forge Military Academy did that for me, and I’m determined to find ways to do that for young Marylanders today.
That includes the Maryland Corps and Service Year Option -- the first statewide program in the country to give high school graduates a year of paid, full-time community service on the path to college or a career.
We have to help young Marylanders find the thing that guides them on a pathway to success and that inspires them to serve. **[If you support that mission, I would appreciate a donation to keep me in the fight as Maryland's governor today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260509-1.8LAdky&refcode=em-20260509-1&t=3&akid=1374%2E1086043%2EyKd53x)**
Elevate,
Wes

When I talk to seniors who did everything right and are now worried about the cost of their prescriptions. When young people in my district tell me that they’ll never be able to buy a home. If we want change, we cannot wait for other people to solve our problems.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131076292/619860557/1557192634?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.09_Amy-Klobuchar-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDVhODZkYS1iMjRiLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lg9kRd1mIIXZVNY1kVguxr5r5VcAnkHtsDL0mDzYEAI=) Donald Trump promised lower prices “on Day One.” But his administration has focused more on making it harder for Americans to vote than on bringing down costs.

Those priorities are completely backwards.

**These moments call for leaders who can stand up and not be a rubber stamp to this administration — and I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful.**

[**_If you’re able, I hope you’ll split a donation between me and Maggie Hassan to support my campaign for governor._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131076302/619860565/1557192634?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.09_Amy-Klobuchar-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDVhODZkYS1iMjRiLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lg9kRd1mIIXZVNY1kVguxr5r5VcAnkHtsDL0mDzYEAI=)

I want to be a transformative governor for Minnesota. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids and for everyone who wants more affordable health care.
