# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2208%2E791427%2EfDmOHn)
Friend, Democrats’ chances of retaking the House this year took a huge hit this week.
States across the South are eliminating majority-Black districts and gerrymandering them into Republican strongholds after SCOTUS decided to gut the Voting Rights Act.
Virginia’s attempt to level the playing field was struck down by the state Supreme Court despite voters approving the new maps, taking five potential new Democratic seats off the table — five seats that were meant to balance out the extreme Republican power grabs in states like Texas.
Trump and Republicans are taking massive swings at our democracy, rigging the system to cement MAGA-rule, **but I am imploring you to have hope.** It may sound corny, but take it from me.
I spent my young life fleeing civil war, living in a refugee camp, and navigating my immigration to America. I didn’t have the luxury of abandoning hope. At times, hope was the only thing that pushed me through. It was what drove me to keep getting back up, to keep moving forward and doing anything I could to change my situation.
Yes, we face an uphill battle. But nothing is impossible. If we can build a massive grassroots movement, the kind we’ve seen in the Civil Rights Movement, the Women’s Rights Movement, and many other fights for justice in our history, **we can win.**
But it’s going to take a big investment from all of us; time, energy, resources, and people-power. We need to organize every day, break the GOP’s rigged political system, and overcome authoritarianism through the sheer will of democracy.
It’s a tough task, but I know we can do it together.
[**If you still have hope, if you’re still in this fight, chip in to my campaign and power our movement. I’m not going anywhere — I’m going to work every day to beat the far-right and unrig the system so that true democracy can flourish in this nation.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may26.WVAuyg&refcode=em260509-1-180&t=2&akid=2208%2E791427%2EfDmOHn)

subject: Tell Congress: Give us our power back
disclaimer_text: Paid for by United for Democracy
body:
Our rapid response to Louisiana v. Callais has been unignorable. Keep up the momentum. | |
---
Peter, It’s been a little over a week since the MAGA Supreme Court gutted voting rights with their ruling in _Louisiana v. Callais_. **Since then, our response has been unignorable.** We launched a rapid response campaign website and spread messaging and social media content far and wide. We hosted a national mobilization call with thousands of attendees. We partnered with Power Coalition to protest in Baton Rouge. **And our national petition to Congress demanding a plan to bring power back to the people has received over 100,000 signatures—thanks to so many of you!** **But now is not the time to slow down. The job is not done until we get real court reform and change the system that’s been rigged against us.** We need to make sure Congress hears from us over and over again. Every time they get a report from their staff, it should include messages from their constituents demanding action. [**Take three minutes and send a message to your members of Congress now. Demand they take action immediately to rein in Supreme Court corruption and bring power back to the people!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOax_Tb2bOJVOyFl36_-dfzE82mSDDG_VK0ftS9ZBBaT7JNTskSLiKSJsfuTK408JLQYRpHtG5H74bKY_eiHVxqJnXXJkhQKNGHTIzol5x-n1p5Scjr5ibjtrfUyGFJL12O9tgTJqou8BlOfLmrmh8FbaO2Vwv5hhvBPo3TsUzn892B67grb7BCvS4cEJ2Uh3r-SnBxyP3EICHKjTqfk0nreE0ev9suahPq11_TortPFJK7XI5k6IseMTtgBntXNj6Yqu4iHlKYiD_gW-tZpneCs5w/4qh/AD7uTj4bQkC44MRrp8QiWw/h0/h001.M_pfn7WmHycFmoDn8IXIm3v_HofLzXEAmj49FUvq5PY) **** [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOax_Tb2bOJVOyFl36_-dfzE82mSDDG_VK0ftS9ZBBaT7JNTskSLiKSJsfuTK408JLQYRpHtG5H74bKY_eiHVxqJnXXJkhQKNGHTIzol5x-n1p6aCGPh8vObCkUg1ZsBUiXQgtsocWn8HfIRnWr87-f_aaDWL6N4rXw0zvCEFEROjuCN172abvLgEtv4pUqB_kR-O2GxuZIQzQsqLB6dB8nqbGLdTqwHnDKGh5s5fBI7UIWhMRd0k9nk7vd_A7DpMbzz-hTBiBH0PBwKGmfoplKLfw/4qh/AD7uTj4bQkC44MRrp8QiWw/h1/h001.fzc_xSEoh7vqnPV36QVOt2t95_BECBuRrJhCQNmTjEw) The Court’s decision tearing down voting rights is a massive attack on our democracy. The ruling will disenfranchise thousands of Black and Brown voters across the country, open the floodgates for gerrymandering, and effectively rig the midterm elections in favor of Republicans. **It’s really, really bad.** And it’s yet another step in a political system that keeps taking power away from everyday people and handing more of it to the wealthy, powerful, and well-connected. **The people in power think we’re going to continue taking their attacks lying down. They want us scared, powerless, and alone. But we’re not.** Together, we can build the movement that will tip the scales back in favor of working families and our communities. When we speak as one, we have the power to make Congress represent us. We can pressure government officials to do the right thing. And we can enact real change. We’ve already made a big splash on Capitol Hill. But the news cycle will continue, and they’ll go back to business as usual—unless we keep up the fight. **That’s why we need everyone to take a few minutes and reach out to their members of Congress right now.** [**Send a message directly to your member of Congress. Tell them America is paying attention, and we expect them to put a plan in place that will reform the Supreme Court, unrig the system, and give power back to the people.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOax_Tb2bOJVOyFl36_-dfzE82mSDDG_VK0ftS9ZBBaT7JNTskSLiKSJsfuTK408JLQYRpHtG5H74bKY_eiHVxqJnXXJkhQKNGHTIzol5x-n1p7E9M556B9rsizQBgXKgrXm-i8tj_WW0aZCdpVXzhNkrEtxqvDBizDUbFUnEHqPHfdyFHm1P74WzDwPoh_Z9xMiFymX-G5dMFH7L_jCvWL3f24jFkp9VHQXnmj9L5DS0jOHAfIjkiP3HyNLTiqIBlQNvsr7bEfoMnI3hgvElmoChQ/4qh/AD7uTj4bQkC44MRrp8QiWw/h2/h001.OoQ0B7lGE1fHHvs312Zj0anspowvEgDsmGG5Ux96eZg) Thank you for keeping up the fight, Ken’Travius Coleman

subject: There's a money machine being built right now to make sure Nevadans never hear from me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Aaron Ford
body:
Let me explain.
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=86%2E127862%2E70ms76)
Poll after poll shows the same thing: **our race for Nevada governor is statistically tied.**
There’s another consistent factor in the polls you should know about: there are plenty of Nevadans across this state who haven't made up their minds yet.
That means that the candidate who reaches the most undecided Nevadans first is going to win this race. Plain and simple.
They're waiting to hear from someone who speaks to their current struggles — with rent, health care, their kids' schools, the list goes on.
**I’m ready to be that person Nevadans can trust to fight for them — but there's a money machine being built _right now_ to make sure they never hear from me.**
As you read this, MAGA Republicans are lining up millions of dollars to flood Nevada with misleading ads, smear campaigns, and wall-to-wall noise engineered to drown out the truth and lock in those undecided voters before we can reach them.
**They're counting on outspending us to make up for the fact that MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo has failed Nevadans time and again.**
I’m counting on members of this team to help our campaign respond, reach voters, and win this toss-up race.

| | | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkUGPnDAMhX-NuTEKDgnDgcNKiFOnUrtVe0QmMRAtISjJTNV_X1HRH7BH-z29T_b79Rgf5Da3L1_JcxfzPMY0TjyHyGllTx-c8uqSZeOSCyMK1KVQpWhPX1XYzhpLlSm4q5rmLusaa1WsnbjLVmhzn6nmRslqssQN2QZNi1pIKlx3Rgkl2kpLUcsbKalQKTPbVrd20lAL2jjmW-TjOW3O0J4pfcwhGr6Z4IutW3M-Esg3wAFwWNyLb0fkKcT9NAAO1wQ4-JBXjqm09AfkkAzI_tG_CYX6_fH-BVCTzyB7vAPqJYHsaQfUz-zHFJ7RMMj-iCEdbLLbl0vybN3Tg-zZk9uupSF_kFt2kP0FPZmXFvbM-wn6qcZvTfn9x1D-f0MRO3v8dtvmkm6gFsuZ-e_Q_PlaXh3-DQAA__-y5ZrX)

Friend of Life, She’s sitting in her car, staring at the building in front of her, trying to convince herself this is the only way forward, even though something inside her keeps saying, _wait... just wait._ She tells herself she doesn’t have time to think. That if she slows down, she might not be able to go through with it. That it’s easier to just move forward with the abortion and deal with everything else later. No one has told her she can pause. No one has told her she can see her baby first. And if nothing interrupts this moment, her decision will be made in minutes. This is the reality for thousands of women right now. And it’s why this moment matters so much. Because when a woman is given the chance to see her baby on an ultrasound, something begins to change in a way that is hard to describe until you see it happen. The screen lights up, the heartbeat fills the room, and suddenly what felt distant and abstract becomes real. She’s no longer thinking about “getting through something.” She’s looking at her child. And in that moment, everything shifts. [**More than 80% of women choose life after seeing their baby on an ultrasound.**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkUGPnDAMhX-NuTEKDgnDgcNKiFOnUrtVe0QmMRAtISjJTNV_X1HRH7BH-z29T_b79Rgf5Da3L1_JcxfzPMY0TjyHyGllTx-c8uqSZeOSCyMK1KVQpWhPX1XYzhpLlSm4q5rmLusaa1WsnbjLVmhzn6nmRslqssQN2QZNi1pIKlx3Rgkl2kpLUcsbKalQKTPbVrd20lAL2jjmW-TjOW3O0J4pfcwhGr6Z4IutW3M-Esg3wAFwWNyLb0fkKcT9NAAO1wQ4-JBXjqm09AfkkAzI_tG_CYX6_fH-BVCTzyB7vAPqJYHsaQfUz-zHFJ7RMMj-iCEdbLLbl0vybN3Tg-zZk9uupSF_kFt2kP0FPZmXFvbM-wn6qcZvTfn9x1D-f0MRO3v8dtvmkm6gFsuZ-e_Q_PlaXh3-DQAA__-y5ZrX) But what matters just as much is what happens after. Months from now, she is not trying to push down a memory or carry the weight of a decision she cannot undo. She is holding her baby. **[This Mother’s Day, while many of us are celebrating the women who gave us life, there are women quietly deciding if they will become mothers at all.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkUGPnDAMhX-NuTEKDgnDgcNKiFOnUrtVe0QmMRAtISjJTNV_X1HRH7BH-z29T_b79Rgf5Da3L1_JcxfzPMY0TjyHyGllTx-c8uqSZeOSCyMK1KVQpWhPX1XYzhpLlSm4q5rmLusaa1WsnbjLVmhzn6nmRslqssQN2QZNi1pIKlx3Rgkl2kpLUcsbKalQKTPbVrd20lAL2jjmW-TjOW3O0J4pfcwhGr6Z4IutW3M-Esg3wAFwWNyLb0fkKcT9NAAO1wQ4-JBXjqm09AfkkAzI_tG_CYX6_fH-BVCTzyB7vAPqJYHsaQfUz-zHFJ7RMMj-iCEdbLLbl0vybN3Tg-zZk9uupSF_kFt2kP0FPZmXFvbM-wn6qcZvTfn9x1D-f0MRO3v8dtvmkm6gFsuZ-e_Q_PlaXh3-DQAA__-y5ZrX)** You can step into that moment. $28 provides one ultrasound. And right now, that ultrasound could be the reason she pauses long enough to see, to understand, and to choose life. Will you help her before that moment passes?

Athena has a unique environmental background. She’s worked in forest restoration and timber stewardship, and she’s running to bring a more community-driven approach to climate policy in Eugene.

David Canepa

Peter, The Supreme Court’s recent ruling narrowing key protections under Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act is a deeply troubling step backward for American democracy and for the hard-won protections of the Voting Rights Act. **Trump’s Supreme Court has gutted the Voting Rights Act in a shameful and unacceptable attack on underrepresented voters across the country.** The Supreme Court has severely weakened one of the last meaningful safeguards against racially discriminatory gerrymandering, stripping away critical protections that prevent states from drawing unfair maps that dilute the voting power of communities of color. This is yet another blow to Black representation in our democracy. This decision paves the way for the largest-ever drop in Black representation in Congress, and it only deepens the urgency of reform to ensure that representation is protected and strengthened. We must mobilize to overcome this attack on our democracy, and it’s up to Congress to act urgently to restore and strengthen the Voting Rights Act to ensure that no court decision turns back the clock on equal representation. Valerie is working in Congress to help strengthen our democracy by protecting everyone’s fundamental right to vote. **Because the right to vote is foundational to our democracy, and we cannot allow it to be eroded.** **[Peter, will you stand with Rep. > There is a reason why the Bible tells us to not be afraid. It says Fear Not 365 times, one for every day. That can't be a coincidence. God knew how hard life would be with all its challenges so he put reminders in His Holy word, 1 for every day. As you walk through this life, Fear Not.
>
> I have spoken across the country for thousands of people. Students, women's events, entrepreneur events, business people who want to grow. The one thing I get asked more than anything is overcoming fear. What I say to them is this; You have to look at fear as an obstacle to overcome. How does one do that? Well, there are many ways to conquer fear. You have to climb over it, go around it, blow it up or go through it.
> [Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=197005658&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk3MDA1NjU4LCJpYXQiOjE3NzgzNDYxODUsImV4cCI6MTc4MDkzODE4NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.gXUudcUc9ONYHNU_5HTZ7uTYux62Q8Ay1w5HZ6byVL0)
> Fear can be paralyzing. It holds us back from our true potential.
>
> I have decided to be the person who lives for the What If? Not the Why Not? The What If is the scarier option.I refuse to be the What If Person.
> I can imagine myself sitting on a front porch 90 years old ( hope I make it there) and say Man, Why didn't I try to do this or that? The most frightening thing to me is regret. Regret that I didn't try. That is actually more scary than failing and being embarrassed , loosing everything and starting from scratch. Which I have had to do in the past years. Yes I got my butt kicked, Yes I lost some things, Yes I lost money... But did I?
> Did I just loose some stuff and also figure out who my real friends are.
> Sometimes the winnowing away is the best in the long run.
>
> What did I learn? Oh my goodness! Enough to write 2 books, which I am in the process of doing.
>
> All of these people I have had conversations with tell me their biggest fear is taking the first step. They are stuck in a trench, unable to move forward.
> [Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.ZeBVnwZ9mAKLZL5cI2GRMAHjyF3GjMGRVXIg3Et5szw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=197005658)
> Then I share with them this visual: In Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade, Indy is in a cave and he comes to a dead end with a huge chasm that won't allow him to cross to the other side. Then he remembers a riddle to his map. Just take the first step out, and the path will appear as if it were magic. He takes a big breath, hoping he doesn't fall to his death. Then there he goes! He steps out, and when he does, a walking stone appears for him to step on, then another and another, and finally it leads him to the other side of this huge cavern.
>
> He took a huge step of faith without knowing his path.
>
> As an entrepreneur you must take the scary steps of faith and Fear Not! Knowing once you do the path will illuminate as you walk. If it's the wrong path don't worry God will let you know and you may get your butt kicked while trying but at least you tried and you just keep going until you find the right one. It's in the trying and never giving up that is the real success. Constantly create , That is true success. God is the ultimate creator and we were made to create.
>
> Lord, be a lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path. Psalms 119: 104-105
>
> Hope this is encouraging to the person in fear. If you always stay on the easy path and the sidewalk you might stay safe and not get hurt...but you might not achieve your full potential either.
>
> I heard this line as a little girl and it has always stuck with me. Reach for the stars, you may not get one but you wont end up with a handful of mud either...
>
> Blessings Gigi
Peanut Butter Cookies

Preheat oven to 375*

Mix together
1/2 cup shortening
1/2 cup peanut butter
1/2 cup white sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
1 egg
Stir In
1 1/4 cup flour
1/2 tsp baking powder
3/4 tsp baking soda
12 tsp salt

Roll into balls and dip into sugar.
Then place on greased baking sheet and flatten with a fork
Bake 10-12 mins
Enjoy

I spent years coaching football, and one thing drove me crazy more than anything else:

_**Teams that played scared.**_

Teams that sat back, waited around, and hoped things would work out.

That's not how you win.

**Right now, Alabama finally has a chance to fight back after years of being pushed around by courts, activists, and people who don 't know a thing about this state.**

And we need to take it.

Alabama is a conservative state.

But for YEARS, we've been forced to live under maps drawn by people outside this state who don't share our values and don't care what Alabama voters actually want.

I'm sick of conservatives always being told to sit quietly while everyone else fights tooth and nail for power.

Enough.

Other states play to win. It's time Alabama did too.

Because when conservatives are in charge, this state does better. More jobs. More growth. More influence in Washington.

I want Alabama on offense--not sitting back playing defense while the other side runs the score up.

**That 's why I'm all in on this fight.**

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. Friend,

When I ran for office, I promised I’d be transparent with you about my work in Congress and how current events are impacting Maryland’s Third District.

In this edition of Sarah Explains It All, I want to pull back the curtain on a situation currently unfolding in the courts that shows us the lasting impact of the so-called “Department of Government Efficiency."

The SituationLast year, the DOGE team uploaded a copy of the Social Security Administration database to the cloud. We’re talking about names, addresses, birthdates, and even the smallest personal details that could be used to steal your identity.

Initially, a federal judge barred DOGE’s access, but the U.S. Supreme Court later granted DOGE open access, a victory for this Administration’s ideological ideas about “efficiency” over the long-term protection of the millions of Americans who rely on the integrity of the Social Security Administration.

The WhyIt has since come to light that one of the primary reasons DOGE and the Administration sought this access was to search for alleged voter fraud. It was never about streamlining our government — it was about using personal data to fuel a false political narrative.

While DOGE officially disbanded in 2025, it doesn’t mean the damage is done. Appeals were filed to hold these bad actors responsible, but earlier this month, the Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals upheld the Supreme Court’s decision.

Dedicated federal workers have fought to regain control of that data, but the Administration fired experts and treated each person as a political bargaining chip. We even have a verb for it now: DOGE’d .

Maryland’s Third District is home to the dedicated civil servants who keep the SSA running, and they deserve better than to have their work undermined by disruptors who bypassed basic security protocols.

I will continue to protect our privacy and support our federal workers who have been affected by DOGE’s actions. If you’re able, please chip in $15 today to help me stay in this fight to protect our workforce and hold this Administration accountable for the mess they’ve made. | Friends and Supporters,

I was appalled to learn this week of **the atrocity occurring in the Peoria school district** , where two teachers took sexual advantage over at least one underage student—possibly several.

_Unfortunately, the outrage doesn’t stop with these perverts_.

Local school district authorities received reports and information regarding this situation previously, and chose to do nothing.

**The one stand-out was school board President Heather Rooks, who called for a third-party investigation of these failures**. In response, and pressured by the Arizona Education Association teachers’ union, the board took a snap vote and ousted her from the presidency.

**The only person who did their job correctly** , and sought accountability on behalf of these children, _got the axe_ because turning over this sordid rock would embarrass the teachers’ union.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. My name is Kendall Qualls. I wasn’t born into privilege or power. I was raised in Harlem, New York, in the 1960s; a child of divorce and one of several siblings living in public housing. Before I reached middle school, I moved to a trailer park in Oklahoma to live with my father. Neither of my parents finished high school.
I didn’t take shortcuts. I worked full-time to put myself through college. I used student loans and paid them back in full. I served as an officer in the United States Army. I earned an MBA from the University of Michigan. Then, I spent 30 years leading teams and driving innovation in the healthcare industry — rising to become Global Vice President of an $850 million business unit.
Now, I’m running for Governor of Minnesota to make sure that the principles that lifted me - hard work, faith, family, personal responsibility, and the free enterprise system - are preserved, defended, and passed on to the next generation.
We don’t need more government. We need more opportunities.
That’s what I’m fighting for, and I need your help. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hey,
I need to show you something.
This week, my Democratic primary opponent appeared on AIPAC's website fundraising alongside Susan Collins — a Republican Senator from Maine.
Let that sink in.
And now a dark money shell organization has dropped $5 million into this race to support her. Together, these two things tell a clear story: the establishment has picked their candidate, and they will spend whatever it takes.
But here's what they can't buy: poll after poll shows I am the strongest candidate in this race — and the only Democrat with the grassroots momentum to beat Mike Rogers in November. My opponent isn't just undermining the path to a Senate majority — she's making it harder for Democrats to hold this seat at all.
Here’s the good thing: we’ve built the biggest grassroots team Michigan has ever seen.

Peter,
My name is Cleo Fields, and I represent Louisiana's Sixth Congressional District. Last week, five unelected extremists on the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act and ruled that my district is unconstitutional for having too many Black voters.
And now MAGA is chomping at the bit. Moving at lightning speed to try and eliminate our majority-Black districts in Louisiana before the 2026 midterm elections. Our MAGA governor went as far as suspending the ongoing May 16th congressional elections--one where votes had already been cast--under the authority of a fake "state of emergency."
We've been on this road before. Black Louisianans have sent exactly four people to Congress since 1877. Four. In a state where more than one in three residents is Black. That is the legacy of Jim Crow.

But I will not roll over while MAGA tries to take Louisiana back to Jim Crow. I am taking this fight to the courts. I am taking it to the streets. I am traveling every corner of this district, looking my constituents in the eye and telling them the truth: we have been here before, and we have survived every time.
[But I need Democrats everywhere to stand with me. Peter,

The foundation of our democracy is simple: we have a government of the people, by the people, and for the people, not a monarchy.

---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2226%2E259176%2EMXi6MJ) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2226%2E259176%2EMXi6MJ)_

Truly. [**Will you help me mark this moment by splitting $10 between my campaign and Blue Amp Action to help us start the general election push strong and keep building our grassroots momentum?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11561?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.09_Brown-Official-Nominee_B3_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=5&akid=2226%2E259176%2EMXi6MJ) | | [CONTRIBUTE](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11561?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.09_Brown-Official-Nominee_B3_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=6&akid=2226%2E259176%2EMXi6MJ)
---
**I came off the sidelines for one reason: Ohio families.**
Life is too expensive. Paychecks are too low. Costs are too high – utilities, health care, groceries, everything.
Ohioans see more money going out the door, and not enough money coming in.
And it’s because the system is rigged. Too many Ohioans are getting the short end of the stick while people in power are doing favors for billionaires and corporate special interests. You are working harder than ever, but you can’t get ahead.
But instead of working to bring down costs and taking on corporate interests, politicians in Washington are making things worse. Politicians like Jon Husted.
Ohio deserves better and Ohioans are showing up and insisting on change. This is an important step in that fight because it brought us _one step_ closer to flipping this seat and retaking Senate control.
**But we also know this battleground race is about to get harder.**
A new poll shows me down by 3 points. National Republicans are pouring $81 million into Ohio to defeat us – more than they’re spending in any other battleground state. And Jon Husted’s super PAC just launched a seven-figure ad buy attacking me.
**They know Ohio is in play. They know we can win. And they know that if we do, we can flip the Senate.**
_The Cook Political Report_ now calls this race a “Toss Up.” That matters. So does the grassroots energy we’ve built together.
That’s why we set an ambitious goal: to raise $1 million by the end of the week so we can make critical investments across the state and reach voters in every corner of Ohio. [**So if you’re able, will you chip in $10, split between my campaign and Blue Amp Action, to help us start the general election strong and flip this seat?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11561?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.09_Brown-Official-Nominee_B3_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=7&akid=2226%2E259176%2EMXi6MJ)

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: I won’t rubber-stamp mass surveillance
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Since I was first elected to Congress, I’ve worked with bipartisan coalitions to push back against unconstitutional government surveillance.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260509-6225-footer&t=1&akid=6225%2E420207%2EUYqsHQ)
Peter,
I didn’t come to Congress to rubber-stamp mass surveillance. I came to build bipartisan coalitions, challenge unconstitutional spying, and defend the Constitution.
I took on warrantless spying under Trump and kept fighting it under President Biden. I’ve challenged leaders in both parties because I refuse to support sweeping surveillance powers.
**This issue isn’t partisan._No_ president, Republican or Democrat, should have unchecked power to spy on the American people.**
Now Trump is back in office, and the danger is too great to ignore. He’s willing to target political opponents, attack journalists, go after immigrants and protesters, and treat any dissent as disloyalty.
[**That’s why I’m asking you to sign on to my petition demanding Donald Trump stop spying on Americans and support real reforms to protect our civil liberties.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260509-fisa-petition/?source=em20260509-6225&t=2&akid=6225%2E420207%2EUYqsHQ)
**[Sign The Petition](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260509-fisa-petition/?source=em20260509-6225&t=3&akid=6225%2E420207%2EUYqsHQ)**
For years, leaders of both parties have defended surveillance powers in Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) in the name of “national security,” even after repeated abuses were exposed.
The FBI has already improperly searched Americans’ communication – and protesters, journalists, and even members of Congress have all been swept up in these systems.
In the past, I’ve worked with a coalition of progressives and libertarians, Democrats and Republicans, to demand reforms — and right now we need that coalition more than ever.
**We need a strong, bipartisan coalition to stand against Trump and his allies as they openly embrace authoritarian tactics. We can’t accept authoritarian tactics as the new normal.**
Grassroots pressure matters in fights like this, which is why I’m asking you to stand with me today.
[**Add your name now to demand an end to unchecked surveillance and call on Donald Trump to stop spying on Americans.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260509-fisa-petition/?source=em20260509-6225&t=4&akid=6225%2E420207%2EUYqsHQ)
**[Add Your Name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260509-fisa-petition/?source=em20260509-6225&t=5&akid=6225%2E420207%2EUYqsHQ)**
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

clean_body: I've enclosed our latest campaign update on the status of this critical runoff election. Please Read: | MESSAGE FROM CHIP ROY Let me be direct. Nearly two million Texans turned out in the Republican Primary for Attorney General—and despite being massively outspent and targeted by the political establishment and their wealthy backers, we forced this race into a runoff. That didn't happen by accident. It happened because the people of Texas still value truth over spin—and results over a bankroll. My opponent poured more than $16 million of his own money into this race, only to finish at 39%. Meanwhile, we were hit by a California-based, left-wing PAC angry that I stood with Donald Trump to strip out hundreds of billions in Green New Deal-style subsidies from the so-called "Big Beautiful Bill." They thought they could buy Texas.They were wrong. The runoff election is May 26 - less than three weeks away - and with your help, we're going to finish what we started and prove, once again, that Texas isn't for sale. But let's be honest about what's at stake. This is no time to hand the Attorney General's office to someone who's never set foot in a courtroom. Texas is facing serious challenges: a wide-open border, foreign adversaries buying up our land, and a radical agenda determined to reshape our state and our country. We need a proven conservative who knows how to fight - and win. The Attorney General isn't a ceremonial role. It's the chief legal officer of the largest conservative state in America. It requires leadership from day one—building a strong legal team, enforcing the law without hesitation, and taking the fight wherever it's needed to defend Texas. I'm ready to do that. But I need to know if conservatives like you are in this fight with me. Between now and May 26th, I'll be working around the clock to make sure Texans understand exactly what's on the line in this runoff. Let's finish this. name: Freedom 250
subject: Join Us May 17th for Rededicate 250 on the National Mall!
body:
A once-in-a-generation gathering of prayer, praise & thanksgiving celebrating 250 years of God's blessings on America.
Join us on May 17 on the National Mall for Rededicate 250 — a once-in-a-generation gathering of prayer, praise & thanksgiving celebrating 250 years of God’s blessings on America.
|
---
A HISTORIC INVITATION
# Join Us for an Historic Moment
of Prayer & Thanksgiving
|
---
You are invited to join us for **Rededicate 250: A National Jubilee of Prayer, Praise & Thanksgiving** on Sunday, May 17 as Americans from across the country come together for a once-in-a-generation gathering on the National Mall in Washington, D.C.
This historic gathering will celebrate **250 years of God’s providence and blessings on the United States** through worship, prayer, music, scripture, testimonies, and a national rededication of our country as one nation under God. The event will feature faith leaders from across the country coming together in gratitude, prayer, and celebration of our great nation as part of our **250th anniversary** and is **FREE to the public**. | | | DATE | Sunday, May 17, 2026
---|---
TIME | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET
---|---
LOCATION | National Mall, Washington, D.C.
---|---
[LEARN MORE & RSVP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.-Cqw/sevf8aee4b4)
---
|

SPEAKERS

PERFORMERS

...and many more! You won’t want to miss it!

name: Sheriff Joe Arpaio
subject: In prison for saving lives? Not on our watch
body:
Patriot,
This is a disgrace...and every American who believes in law and order should be furious.
Two police officers—Josh Taylor and Brandon Dingman—are currently serving prison sentences for doing exactly what they were trained and ordered to do: respond to a dangerous call, use non-lethal force, and protecting their community.
Let me tell you what really happened, because the media and the District Attorney certainly won't.
On the night of July 4th, 2019, Officer Josh Taylor responded to a domestic disturbance call in Wilson, Oklahoma. When he arrived, he encountered Jared Lakey: a large, fully grown man walking naked down the street wearing nothing but socks.
Josh immediately recognized this situation for what it was: dangerous and unpredictable. Whether it was drugs, mental illness, or something else—this wasn't a man in his right mind. And Josh knew he couldn't handle it alone. He called for backup.
[Donate to Their Defense](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=418da85549ba4b539d8adb49743806dd&_e=7mIQYFn6DCM-HASiWmbLYLp5nAl1r4L5gFGIJ-oyXclHeVmkXMBATSdz3G-RvwooTC4VF4Tz2rJVsszSqtqjshDwNvCsfa6j24m7IUycsye83O83-1xp4MaH8VdvaECAfRsDctp26ETelJjlSZgkkXJysQl9QhhE8X1mtwqOyADxOWz-X0snoHdXla4GZSUTMQQ8_h5Az3BqOBfcypf9SuSZbK4Pu46WjqCDrCVlSTHIE7NHas2u4DTho2v9LXcl2eu3sSzvsHf1N6CG9LYx2ootoOj5mFdxfP92SUK4mArzNizDyF7tSIpqKa4Hkd3fzTDnXwXF7LMC3I-mROpyMJK1Tmk5Laa52RoGmBBui92ae8D_rIbojZAtlndv79aMODjNDHLSfGKlDJDOMmgKW_cq7PMqLY7ui22IYfDVtFoo0ig0mqPhYa2Vzg1kyN2-)
Officer Josh Taylor
Officer Brandon Dingman
Officer Brandon Dingman arrived on scene, and the two officers tried to do what they were trained to do: safely and professionally bring Mr. Lakey into custody.
But Lakey was 350 pounds, combative, and resisting arrest. When verbal commands didn't work and physical restraint proved impossible, they turned to their department-issued, non-lethal tasers.
They deployed them multiple times, but Lakey kept tearing the barbs out. He was clearly not being fully affected by the tasers—and even after repeated attempts, the officers were unable to subdue him.
Eventually, Josh and Brandon were able to get his arms and cuffed him. They immediately called for medical assistance. An ambulance arrived. Lakey was taken to the hospital.
At that point, the officers had done everything they could—and everything right.
But tragically, Jared Lakey passed away two days later. The autopsy was inconclusive. He had an enlarged heart and lung issues. Drug screenings were unreliable due to the fluids pumped into his system at the hospital. There was no determined cause of death.
Even so, the department launched an internal review. Then the City Council reviewed the case too.
Both cleared the officers. That's two separate investigations concluding Josh and Brandon followed procedure.
Case closed, right?
Wrong.
A full year later, a politically motivated District Attorney, smelling an opportunity, dragged the case back up and charged these officers with second-degree murder.
Let that sink in: second-degree murder. He ignored the internal findings. He ignored the medical uncertainty. He ignored the fact that these officers never even laid a hand on Lakey's neck or airway.
They followed their training, used the gear they were issued, and even called for medical help.
But none of that mattered to a DA looking to make headlines.
Now, these two good cops, family men, community protectors, are sitting behind bars.
The National Center for Police Defense is fighting to overturn this injustice. We're supporting their legal appeals, helping their families, and backing efforts to remove the biased District Attorney who never should have touched this case in the first place.
But appeals are costly. And the longer this drags on, the longer Josh and Brandon sit in prison...separated from their families, their children, their lives.
That's why I'm writing you today. We need your help.
[Yes — I'll Donate Today](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=418da85549ba4b539d8adb49743806dd&_e=7mIQYFn6DCM-HASiWmbLYLp5nAl1r4L5gFGIJ-oyXclHeVmkXMBATSdz3G-RvwooTC4VF4Tz2rJVsszSqtqjshDwNvCsfa6j24m7IUycsyeQauroWCwNSNtOPtNKb7GhefKyAOIIKd4aC5Fs8Suf2kOG3sKgZrZcKNDcxX84fKYZKFSuOz_Q6Tx1qPQteDiMZLODmDHUNSMjOaG_9H0zUJAWy2o9iz_O9rVMrYw0SUttlo-e-oUewPzfnS-gORGM2LcXOmJKG7osQ4GLmQMJ92l0EW8barp0wWc2nxnnm7YbKEX0Kdpj_Vhoq6MQ9sJ9qssQC9jsRKz0w6cVlp5m8MutbwfaiF7rT0cqLBucS_N-FEhls_znaJ_r-1eS7-PR9YaoK5EeqlyWJYEtWA7HITJymiMoMvqzQ9Obyr4n2jeDW44oE6GciIV2i-h1ncAz)
We need to raise funds to fuel the legal defense and appeal process. These officers deserve their freedom. They deserve a fair hearing. And they deserve to come home.
We cannot let this go unanswered. If we don't stand up now, more and more police officers will suffer the same fate: thrown to the wolves by political activists in prosecutor's clothing.
Josh and Brandon were railroaded, plain and simple. And now we need to right this wrong.
Will you step up today and donate to support their appeals?
## Stand With Josh & Brandon
Every dollar goes directly to their legal defense and appeals. Help bring them home.
[Click Here to Donate](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=418da85549ba4b539d8adb49743806dd&_e=7mIQYFn6DCM-HASiWmbLYLp5nAl1r4L5gFGIJ-oyXclHeVmkXMBATSdz3G-RvwooTC4VF4Tz2rJVsszSqtqjshDwNvCsfa6j24m7IUycsycdHSYrf3Zdv1mjx-0S1t8Qjv__TcdViarp2iKhYqgNUELZL4EHdgJ_EYy1IExWZlyzidgkIiFxtDoK5EqIUAkNTGSedkA8PGMgwWU6dbOOochlVjLNEPQuqIjF7M5vTFmIWamE2ZsCbe8pujT_wfrWljpugJyJpNB-SItQJO86UUmE88B34Afqx3KM6tRsV51db9UeyZo4IjFG77X_DCIXdToyDgo8cnd0cUUDb1VekTUhBRfE9iY_SZMkhpubHXSdS8GUQtkOeVLSg8CtCxEMKNZY05yRU56O2kijhS9j6cSHWAcB-fFnZNO_5y7H93btTR9bwpfDch78eGbGFT84)
Your generous gift goes to defending these officers and restoring justice. No family should have to go through this. No officer should be imprisoned for doing his job.
Let's send a message: we still back the badge—and we won't let politics destroy the lives of our heroes.
For justice,
Sheriff Joe Arpaio (ret.)
National Center for Police Defense | Defenders for Justice

clean_body: Our plan isn’t to outraise Republicans. It’s to outstrategize them. | = Peter, Bad news: Republicans are already putting up strong fundraising numbers as we approach the 2026 midterms. Good news: We’ve never built a majority by playing defense. That’s why earlier this year, we launched Mission Majority , our plan to expand the U.S. House battlefield, create multiple paths to victory, and flip the nation’s most competitive seats with Democratic women. = | = We can’t just try to match Republican fundraising dollar-for-dollar. We’ve also got to outstrategize them. Here’s our game plan: 🗺️ Mapping out a 50+ race battlefield across the country, creating multiple paths to victory. 🎯 Identifying Majority Maker seats we can win to take back control of the House. 🛡️ Protecting frontline incumbent women in must-defend, high-stakes races. ⛰️ Navigating tough-terrain opportunities — historically red-leaning districts where MAGA extremism has now opened the door for our women to compete and win. We know this moment is critical to taking back the U.S. House. Just hours after the Supreme Court weakened the Voting Rights Act, many Republicans across the country started calling to redraw maps and lock in more power.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
They see an opening — and they’re moving fast to take advantage of it, because they know what’s at stake: control of Congress.

Hi team,
**We 're less than two weeks from Pennsylvania's Primary Election Day.**
Our part of Pennsylvania has been overlooked for a long time. A lot of people have said that Democrats can't win here. That we're not worth the investment or the effort.
The national Democratic Party has forgotten about us. But every day I talk to Democrats, Independents, and Republicans who remind me why this race matters. Because we deserve better.
The tide is turning in PA. The counties in this district shifted an average of **33 points** in four years. We had more individual donors in the last two quarters than Dan Meuser. We're gaining momentum every single day.
**If we have a strong turnout on May 19th, we can really turn some heads and get our message out there. We can show everyone who wrote off our district that the people here are ready for change. And we can make sure every voter here knows that it 's possible.**
[CHIP IN](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/16b101c5-a8e0-4dcc-b0d0-9625289fbd44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Even though I'm the only Democrat on the ballot, this primary is really important to me.
**Because I want Democrats to know that I 'm here **_**asking**_**for your support. I 'm here to tell you who I am, what I stand for, and ask for your vote. I'm not taking it for granted.**
**[If you're already with me, thank you. I'm grateful to have you on the team. If you can, please chip in to help me reach every Democrat in our part of PA before Election Day.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/16b101c5-a8e0-4dcc-b0d0-9625289fbd44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Let's get to work.
Gratefully,
Rachel Wallace

| The national environment is moving hard against Republicans. Trump's approval is underwater, voters are blaming him for rising costs, and Democrats have the enthusiasm edge heading into the midterms. In most years, that would point to a major Democratic opportunity.
But Donald Trump and the Republicans know it too...
That's why they've been so focused on redistricting, especially after the Supreme Court tore down what little remains of the Voting Rights Act. Louisiana is moving to redraw its maps, Tennessee Republicans are trying to wipe out a Democratic seat, Florida Republicans are pushing for more GOP seats, and the Cook Political Report estimates Republicans could gain anywhere from 5 to 14 seats from redistricting alone.
So while, yes, the national mood is against them, they're rigging the maps to keep power anyway.
That's why we're setting a big goal: We need to make this our best fundraising month ever, so GOTV PAC has the resources to endorse in up to 5 more races before November.
If Democrats want to overcome Republican gerrymandering and take back the House, we have to expand the battlefield now and play in every race that's still up for grabs.

Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.

This is unacceptable, team. While families are struggling to put gas in their cars and food on the table, Trump wants to give **$1.5 TRILLION** taxpayer dollars to fuel his reckless war abroad. He wants to increase the military budget by 40% AND cut $73 billion from domestic spending. Meanwhile, he says it’s “not possible” to pay for Medicaid, Medicare, and child care. **How is that “America first”?** Right now, we're losing American jobs: 10,000 per month. body:
Together, we will flip this seat blue and take back the House.

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131097890/619926621/485628887?refcode2=260509_em_markwarner&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_PerrielloSplit_260509_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOTljZDQ3OC1kZDRiLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5QOuX0nkrMI73-ZKpqRITS5cXl4n9twhh45VHCbZyoo=) Yesterday was a reminder that powerful people will always try to protect power, even when it comes at the expense of voters and our democracy.

They will use every threat and trick. By overturning the new maps and the will of Virginia voters, the Virginia Supreme Court today joins those who have capitulated when they had their chance to put our country and Constitution first.

That is the job of historians. **My job is urgent and clear – I am going to defeat Rep. John McGuire and flip Virginia’s Fifth District.** I am the only Democrat to win this district in a generation, and I am going to do it again this year, with your help. These midterms are _game over_ or _game on_ for our Constitution and system of checks and balances.

The people of Central and Southside Virginia cannot afford two more years of this chaos, corruption, and cruelty from Washington. Our food banks are bursting at the seams from historic levels of hunger, because of SNAP cuts and food prices. Emergency rooms are overflowing because of Medicaid cuts and premium hikes. _Folks do not expect Washington to solve every problem, but they do expect their elected representatives, like McGuire, not to make their lives worse._

Our region deserves real representation. In listening sessions across our region, people on the right, left and center agree on one thing – McGuire needs to be fired. He could have chosen to fight for our communities, but McGuire chose instead to duck and cover. He has voted to take more money out of our pockets, and refused to answer to constituents who ask him why.

**Folks across Central and Southside Virginia know that I am a fighter. That I listen. And that my priority will be immediate economic relief for families across our communities.** From expanding affordable healthcare to repairing the Robertson Bridge, I will focus on what brings down costs, pushes up paychecks, and forces the powerful to play by the same set of rules as the rest of us.

_We are going to win this seat back for the people. I am the only Democrat in a generation to win a congressional race in Virginia's Fifth District, when I flipped the seat in 2008 against a six-term Republican incumbent._

Since launching my campaign, I have been in every corner of this district. I have sat with the farmers getting crushed by tariffs, the families choosing between groceries and gas, and the young people who wonder if home ownership has become a thing of the past. I am more determined than ever to fight for everyone to get a fair shot, and to flip this district.

**I am locked in. I am ready to win this. But I need your help. If you can channel that outrage and frustration into action, please commit today to helping our campaign.**

Sir, I am a 70 year old Black man and I know what it means to be called “Boy.”
| | | | | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BeesM38wDsX00Gibvj_DshN3xC300KcyUcy7tjiZKcCdfXD9U9dbwsqI1be9p7oA6BkwN865YXzqLinvhbsjl40MNXPtrejhfJOY_GzcuAgdsFrz4EEDeKCYNq3Fgc-a81UMFlB65xAQLuDtzKx0JV1zXx7RvMfD_rr4vMk4VdiSbvrkbvnr-6od1qu1hTyupI4RAALCtizr16bXToAfKmXFAPsPyeZp&c=jnbIUysmwTCxprb9KrAgWhngzCBwE5ZcNx5r_B1wMt74GYo-TMqPaw==&ch=aH8M7KFhg2R1ufR8dQ4XDEL4cobb9Vrzdphg3qsbSwEawD_3IfXaCw==)
---
| Peter,
On Friday morning over 600 hundred Louisianans showed up to the Louisiana state capitol to protest and speak out against a new Congressional map proposed by the Louisiana GOP that will erase Louisiana's two black majority districts and establish all white districts.
During the hearing on redistricting, GOP State Senator Jay Morris yelled "Shut up, boy" to my Executive Director Dadrius Lanus, a Black man, who, in Sen. Morris's words was "commenting and talking" too loudly for him to concentrate.
Sir, I am a 70 year old Black man and we know what it means to be called "Boy."
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BeesM38wDsX00Gibvj_DshN3xC300KcyUcy7tjiZKcCdfXD9U9dbwsqI1be9p7oA6BkwN865YXzqLinvhbsjl40MNXPtrejhfJOY_GzcuAgdsFrz4EEDeKCYNq3Fgc-a81UMFlB65xAQLuDtzKx0JV1zXx7RvMfD_rr4vMk4VdiSbvrkbvnr-6od1qu1hTyupI4RAALCtiw1vvPR3bXbrGXRydPN0AwG&c=jnbIUysmwTCxprb9KrAgWhngzCBwE5ZcNx5r_B1wMt74GYo-TMqPaw==&ch=aH8M7KFhg2R1ufR8dQ4XDEL4cobb9Vrzdphg3qsbSwEawD_3IfXaCw==)
---
Senator Morris says we misheard. That the audio proves it. That he said "you all need to shut up" to the Black constituents behind him outraged that their votes won't be counted.
Senator Morris, an elected member of our legislature, thinks if he had yelled "you all need to shut up" it would be better.
It wouldn't.
What Senator Morris doesn't understand is that White people have been telling Black folk to "shut up" for over 250 years.
What Senator Morris doesn't understand is that we remember being told we were 3/5ths of a person. That even when we won personhood in the eyes of the law, they instituted poll taxes and "reading" tests. That when we marched and dreamed and cried and buried loved ones who had hung as strange fruit from tall trees because they raised their voices too loud that what Black people have always wanted is equality.
Or maybe Senator Morris does understand all that.
I don't know.
What I do know is that I am a 70 year old Black man. And I don't let anyone call me or my brothers "Boy."
[Please, chip in even $1 today. Let's show Senator Morris that they might have gutted the Voting Rights Act and canceled our election. But we shall not be silenced.](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BeesM38wDsX00Gibvj_DshN3xC300KcyUcy7tjiZKcCdfXD9U9dbwsqI1be9p7oAZP-3l3AmmREl6_nwMi-qYtFebPXXOl9qsxwtUqjzm6cm8G7kKYY22QOI7ekg5xtNZQFo5NCOY59fiYUbG-ooFiOjwio6n9MqVmT7vEjmWNpbr4u2cXKpm8u_9J7Ha3KDDfiBxRnL0pc7itPEVuinkk9V5nrDFWScOJRHOV2WGH4=&c=jnbIUysmwTCxprb9KrAgWhngzCBwE5ZcNx5r_B1wMt74GYo-TMqPaw==&ch=aH8M7KFhg2R1ufR8dQ4XDEL4cobb9Vrzdphg3qsbSwEawD_3IfXaCw==)

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
May 9, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**NEW POLL: JULIA LETLOW HAS COMMANDING LEAD IN U.S. SENATE RACE** _LETLOW DOMINATING THE FIELD WITH A DOUBLE DIGIT LEAD_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — A new independent [poll](https://us.list-manage.com/YxNwdGfCFw3?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a) shows Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed candidate for U.S. Senate in Louisiana, continuing to build overwhelming momentum in Louisiana’s Republican U.S. Senate primary, expanding her lead and solidifying her position as the clear frontrunner in the race.
The poll shows **Congresswoman** **Letlow leading the field with 42% support** , compared to D.C. lobbyist John Fleming at 29.6% and Senator Bill Cassidy at 19.6%.
**Quantus Insights’ analysis of the race stated:**

_”The significance is not merely that Letlow leads. It is how the race arrived here. In Quantus’ February 23–24 survey, Fleming stood in front with 34.2%, while Letlow sat at 24.6%. Cassidy was at 19.8%, and more than one in five voters remained undecided. By May, Letlow had climbed roughly seventeen points, Fleming had fallen roughly five, Cassidy had scarcely moved, and the undecided vote had meaningfully compressed. The electorate did not scatter. It sorted.”_
The polling also demonstrates Letlow’s commanding strength in potential runoff matchups. In a head-to-head race against Bill Cassidy, **Letlow leads 63.0% to** 23.4%. Against D.C. lobbyist John Fleming, **Letlow leads 45.4%** to 39.6%.
Among strong MAGA and America First voters, **Letlow holds an even more decisive advantage, leading D.C. lobbyist Fleming by more than 20 points, 52.4% to 31.2%** , underscoring the strength of her support among the conservative base of the Republican electorate.
---
|
---
| | The new numbers mark another major milestone for Letlow’s campaign, which has continued to gain strength across Louisiana as voters rally behind President Trump’s endorsed conservative in the race. The poll also underscores the growing contrast between Letlow’s campaign and Senator Cassidy’s continued collapse with Republican voters.
Since entering the race with President Trump’s complete and total endorsement, Letlow has built a broad coalition of support across Louisiana by focusing on conservative values, support for the America First agenda, protecting parents’ rights, securing the border, strengthening Louisiana’s energy industry, and delivering results for Louisiana families.
To learn more visit [JuliaLetlow.com](https://us.list-manage.com/17YiRpL4I_O?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a).

### **Democrats do not deserve support**
The co-optation of the Democratic Party is nothing new. I've [dedicated years](https://substack.com/redirect/d464abf2-f1f5-492f-a8e3-ac3e3eb64513?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of my life to confronting it directly, and written any number of articles exploring and [explaining](https://substack.com/redirect/eb2cfb63-0558-4fdc-ba97-cd1ab9f9f19a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it to more casual observers.
The party's leaders in the Senate have [enabled](https://substack.com/redirect/68215600-b6aa-441a-9e2d-4da6786219c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Trump's most enduring actions, including [unprovoked wars](https://substack.com/redirect/3c68e0bc-899c-4d53-9bc9-28fe3674ce3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as well as the expansion of ICE into an unaccountable federal paramilitary goon squad used to suppress dissent and [murder](https://substack.com/redirect/345e9538-5d66-47b5-ac75-cb82b1a68790?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) innocent people with impunity in broad daylight.
Despite the party's consistent reliance on support from communities of color, its longtime leader in the House unapologetically [relied](https://substack.com/redirect/30c12feb-4ad0-417c-b635-50ce8987f313?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on white supremacy to insulate herself from electoral accountability the one time she faced a threat in a November election, while ducking public debates and [imposing](https://substack.com/redirect/c4c1ac35-63f2-479c-86e9-2595fb40bb2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) conservative policy priorities--including ironclad support for Israel, Wall Street, and the Pentagon--for nearly 40 years.
As I [noted](https://substack.com/@shahidbuttar/note/c-248261267) on this platform just the other day:
> The Democratic Party defends the same interests as Republicans.
> They're not opposition.
> They're enablers.
No one outraged by the fascism that has grown all-too-apparent in the U.S. over the past decade (after [festering](https://substack.com/redirect/e015bad8-f9a1-41b0-baa8-672ec2aff2ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the shadows for long before that) is going to find a solution in the Democratic Party.
### **America desperately needs new voices**
Recognizing the bizarre [ossification](https://substack.com/redirect/ebfc8c58-7605-4b38-bb87-726edde020ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Washington, and the gerontocracy that has entrenched itself despite its recurring and ongoing failures, many observers have supported structural solutions, such as term limits.
But, as I've [noted](https://substack.com/redirect/3699fead-1a33-4f73-a5b6-af916dfe326a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), forcing turnover in the cast of characters in no way changes the play--it just changes the particular faces and personalities chosen to continue perpetrating the same fraud on well-meaning people who don't know where to turn for alternatives.
But we have alternatives, and none are better poised--or prepared--than Butch Ware.
### **An academic-artist-activist-athlete-organizer**
I'll admit from the outset that one reason I'm so excited about Ware's campaign is that we seem to be cut from remarkably similar cloth. I've been described as a [renaissance](https://substack.com/redirect/6373b6bb-cd3f-47c9-a63b-38b8378eacc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) man based on the diversity among my various pursuits, and I have yet to encounter anyone else who happened to choose such precisely identical pathways for expression and resistance.
Butch is a hip-hop MC, historian, professor, prolific public speaker, direct action organizer, professional athlete, and candidate for public office. To be fair, he's more accomplished in each of those arenas than I ever will, which is among the reasons I'd be excited to see him leading our state.
To his credit, Butch also seems refreshingly humble, describing [his story](https://substack.com/redirect/325790fc-5d6d-49bc-af49-68146c1fb627?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in his own words as if his combination of talents and achievements fell into his lap:
> I got to become an emcee and a professional baseball player and still finish a PhD....
> I became a PhD because I found out in school that I was better at school than I was at baseball. But before that, it was all sports for me. So, long story short....I was teaching at the University of Michigan at the time. I looked for a place to stay in shape, and I ended up getting recruited for a team in the French Elite League, and as a 40-year-old, I took the team...to the championship.....
Beyond his tremendous life story and the diverse array of communities to which he has contributed, Butch also proposes a [visionary policy platform](https://substack.com/redirect/bf0c4ca8-6db5-4070-9e81-0f8db77c87c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that would make an immense difference in the lives of working class Californians.
The vision of [distributive justice](https://substack.com/redirect/bf0c4ca8-6db5-4070-9e81-0f8db77c87c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Butch Ware proposes goes to the heart of economic disparities and the affordability crisis. For instance, he has proposed plans to [end California's longstanding housing crisis](https://substack.com/redirect/bf0c4ca8-6db5-4070-9e81-0f8db77c87c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by supporting vacancy taxes, social housing, and rent control. Butch also proposes universal, [single-payer healthcare](https://substack.com/redirect/bf0c4ca8-6db5-4070-9e81-0f8db77c87c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through a plan that would end the racket of corporate health insurance and make care free at the point of use for every Californian.
Butch also supports labor to a greater extent than any Democrat. He supports a statewide $25/hr minimum wage, as well as a California Public Bank poised to put the state's resources to work for workers across California. He also wants to establish a publicly owned energy grid built by union workers.
His plans go beyond distributive justice to also include dramatic protections for civil rights and civil liberties. For instance, Butch wants to Make California [a genuine sanctuary](https://substack.com/redirect/bf0c4ca8-6db5-4070-9e81-0f8db77c87c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for immigrants by closing ICE detention facilities relying on state contracts, and ending state cooperation by state authorities with federal immigration enforcement.
Butch also wants to end the era of mass incarceration, by releasing incarcerated people who remain locked up for "crimes" that are no longer illegal, and building a crisis response system based on care, rather than policing.
Perhaps most radically, Butch aims to [return stewardship](https://substack.com/redirect/3dfc3fc9-3a55-4166-9217-5ddb127c79bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of state-held lands to indigenous communities from which they were taken, and create the nation's first Reparations Task Force to provide cash reparations to repair multi-generational harm from slavery.
His platform reaches principles and communities beyond those embraced by Democrats, who tend to quibble at the margins while conceding the underlying legitimacy of right wing policies.
Butch envisions a different approach not only to governing, but also the process of campaigning for public office. For instance, he has gone far beyond how most political campaigns engage the public by compiling a statewide [mutual aid directory](https://substack.com/redirect/0407768c-4808-47ab-9bff-860223ba7d4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

### **Hypocritically restricting ballot access**
Ballot access is perhaps the most direct--and hypocritical--way that Democrats disrespect voters. Democrats have fairly criticized the Supreme Court for reviving the Jim Crow era through its recent [decision inviting unrestrained racial gerrymandering](https://substack.com/redirect/c89daba4-18ac-4c82-bcd5-a3e06e3b3b4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the country, while at the same time working to block voters in California from even seeing their choices.
This week, Californians received our ballots by mail. But one of the leading candidates for Governor--the only Black candidate with statewide support--doesn't appear on the ballot.
California requires gubernatorial candidates to submit five years of tax returns. Ware complied with the requirement, only to be arbitrarily disqualified by the Secretary of State--a Democrat, acting as a loyal partisan to protect his party from electoral accountability.
When Ware challenged his disqualification in court, he encountered a pattern similar to what I discovered when I sought redress for corporate newspapers [publishing racist lies](https://substack.com/redirect/6c22f5e3-cd70-4212-9b79-f5ab61881d15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with reckless disregard for the truth, in violation of [well-established federal law](https://substack.com/redirect/7ba471fb-38ce-4844-b21f-09d698c4d8cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Both of us have confronted arbitrary decisions by lower court judges who have simply ignored clear legal requirements in order to protect the political establishment.
As Butch has [explained](https://substack.com/redirect/325790fc-5d6d-49bc-af49-68146c1fb627?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) publicly:

### **California could continue leading the country**
California is the most [populous](https://substack.com/redirect/1e152928-abc2-4ec7-8718-f46dac75e2f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and most [prosperous](https://substack.com/redirect/22e577a0-9cf4-4da4-90a9-beab66890dbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), state in the Union. It includes the [highest](https://substack.com/redirect/55413c0a-96bf-40c5-b0b4-eefcaae64f06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) point in the lower 48 states, as well as the [lowest](https://substack.com/redirect/67a0c9d2-d232-4ace-94de-fe81ccd160f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--barely 100 miles away.
Its major cities include the country's cultural capital (Los Angeles), as well as its former counter-cultural capital and current epicenter of the technology sector (the San Francisco Bay Area) that increasingly drives the national economy.
Many Americans forget that California used to be [part of Mexico](https://substack.com/redirect/0c759b18-ca9e-4d06-8fd2-31febddc486f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) before Washington secured it through conquest.
